description:
The Team + The Role

Pendo’s Enterprise Sales team drives growth across the company’s largest and most strategic accounts. The team partners with senior business and technology leaders to position Pendo as a critical platform for product experience, data, analytics, and digital transformation. In DACH, this team plays a key role in expanding Pendo’s presence with major enterprise customers and prospects.

As a Senior Account Executive, you will own new business across Pendo’s largest DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close, with a focus on $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities. This role requires a strategic enterprise seller who can build executive relationships, create disciplined account plans, and position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics solutions with clarity and urgency.

This role is based in our Munich office.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • New logo acquisition: Win new enterprise logos across Germany within Pendo’s most strategic segment. You will identify, engage, and convert high-value opportunities across large DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts.
  • Enterprise sales execution: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close. You will navigate matrixed organizations, align executive buyers, and keep deals moving with clear next steps and strong commercial discipline.
  • Strategic deal leadership: Consistently drive $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities by building value-based business cases. You will position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics platform as a critical driver of digital transformation for enterprise customers.
  • Executive relationship building: Build trusted relationships with C-level leaders and senior decision-makers. You will engage stakeholders with credibility, understand their priorities, and connect Pendo’s capabilities to strategic business outcomes.
  • Account planning: Develop and execute clear, strategic account plans for target enterprise accounts. You will map stakeholders, identify growth opportunities, and create focused plans that support new business acquisition and long-term account potential.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Collaborate across Pendo to win and expand strategic accounts. You will partner with internal teams to bring the right expertise into each opportunity and create a strong, coordinated customer experience.
  • Pipeline and forecast discipline: Maintain accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline management. You will keep opportunity data current, communicate deal progress clearly, and manage your business with structure and accountability.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Account Executives don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

  • Strong track record of closing $500K–$1M+ enterprise SaaS deals across DACH.
  • Experience selling into large, complex, matrixed organizations with multiple senior stakeholders and executive buyers.
  • Proven success in a start-up or high-growth environment, with the ability to operate with structure, urgency, and ownership.
  • Background selling Data, Analytics, AI, or enterprise technology solutions.
  • Passion for AI and technology, with genuine curiosity about how AI is changing the way people work.
  • Confident engagement style with C-level leaders, senior decision-makers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Structured, strategic, and highly self-driven approach to account planning, pipeline management, and deal execution.
  • Fluent German and professional English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling into DAX 40 prospect accounts or similarly large strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Experience positioning AI-powered Data & Analytics solutions as part of broader digital transformation initiatives.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.

Benefits: Robust, employer-backed social coverage paired with additional cash stipends, equity, and meaningful retirement and commute support.

EEOC: We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility: Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. description: Health can’t wait. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices. ⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy. You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs. Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive. Why is our Vertical approach interesting? Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan. Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum. Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction. Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth. What will you do with us? You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€. At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless. We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base. Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew. ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for? You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you: Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role; Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English. Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills; Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems; Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building; Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models; Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team; Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1; Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range. If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France. Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport. description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accountant (m/f/d) based in France. As an Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the accounting operations of German entities within an international software group. You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, contribute to month-end and year-end closing processes, and ensure compliance with German accounting standards and tax regulations. Working closely with the finance team, external tax advisors, and payroll providers, you will help deliver reliable financial reporting and maintain strong internal controls. You will also contribute to budgeting, variance analysis, and financial performance monitoring to support informed business decisions. This fully remote opportunity offers a hands-on environment where you can improve existing processes, bring structure to financial operations, and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional seeking to grow within an international, entrepreneurial, and collaborative team. Accountabilities: Manage day-to-day accounting activities for German legal entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial records. Support month-end and year-end closing procedures, including journal entries, accounting adjustments, and financial analysis. Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support the review of account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness. Follow up with vendors regarding missing invoices, prepare cost accruals, and contribute to profit and loss (P&L) reviews. Process supplier payments and bank transfers, ensuring that the appropriate approvals and internal procedures are followed. Reconcile intercompany transactions and investigate discrepancies to maintain consistent financial records across entities. Prepare German VAT filings, including Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung and Zusammenfassende Meldung, and support payroll tax declarations (Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung) in collaboration with external payroll providers and tax advisors. Assist with the preparation of annual financial statements in accordance with German Commercial Code (HGB) requirements, as well as statutory audits and tax filings. Maintain and strengthen internal financial controls, accounting procedures, and compliance practices. Review and improve existing accounting processes, resolve outstanding items, clean up historical ledger discrepancies, and establish more efficient financial workflows. Prepare financial KPIs and management reports, validating data accuracy and consistency before submission. Support monthly variance analysis by comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts, investigating discrepancies, and providing relevant insights. Collaborate with the wider finance team on daily accounting operations, reporting activities, process improvements, and special projects. Requirements: At least 3 years of professional accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for German accounting practices under HGB and German tax requirements. Experience in the software, technology, or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) industry. Solid understanding of accrual accounting, financial reconciliations, journal entries, closing procedures, and financial reporting. Practical knowledge of German VAT requirements and familiarity with payroll tax declarations and statutory reporting obligations. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with the ability to work confidently with financial data and accounting reports. Experience with NetSuite or similar accounting and enterprise resource planning systems is an advantage. Experience managing multiple legal entities or multi-currency accounting is a plus. A professional qualification in accounting, bookkeeping, or a related discipline is desirable. Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and reliability, with a commitment to maintaining high standards in financial documentation and reporting. A proactive, problem-solving mindset and willingness to resolve historical accounting issues, organize incomplete records, and improve existing processes. Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and take ownership of responsibilities in a fully remote environment. Strong teamwork and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate proactively with colleagues, external advisors, and service providers across remote teams. Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new systems, expand responsibilities, and develop professionally over time. Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken. Residence in Europe and legal authorization to work in the country of residence. Being based in or near Berlin is an advantage. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement: Work remotely from an eligible location within Europe. International working environment: Collaborate with finance professionals and stakeholders across an international software group. Entrepreneurial team culture: Benefit from a hands-on environment that encourages ownership, initiative, and practical problem-solving. Professional development: Expand your accounting expertise and gain exposure to international financial operations, reporting, and process improvement. description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering team.

The area sits at the heart of some of the most critical customer journeys and commercial systems across Vinted’s Marketplace Business Unit, spanning Revenue (pricing and advertising), Purchase (inquiries and checkout), and Orders (transactions and fulfilment). Together, these domains create a rich, high-volume, and deeply interconnected data ecosystem.

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of data, engineering, and product, building trusted data products that power business and product decision-making across these domains.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Build scalable data products: Design, develop, and evolve reliable, cost-efficient data products and pipelines that power analytics and machine learning use cases across the domains.
  • Build quality in by design: Embed automated testing, validation, and quality controls throughout the data lifecycle to ensure data remains accurate, consistent, and complete.
  • Strengthen observability: Improve monitoring and alerting to detect and address issues before they impact downstream consumers.
  • Own production reliability: Take end-to-end ownership of production data systems, from investigating incidents and diagnosing root causes to implementing durable fixes that prevent recurrence and improve long-term resilience.

Who you’ll work with:

  • Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering: Join a talented and driven team of 7+ Analytics Engineers, working across interconnected domains and tackling complex, high-impact data challenges.
  • Data & Decision Scientists: Work closely with Data Scientists and Decision Scientists to build trusted data foundations that enable better business and product decisions.
  • Engineering, Product & Business: Partner with Backend Engineering, Product, and Business teams to understand their needs, shape technical requirements, and translate them into well-designed, trusted data solutions.
  • The Analytics Engineering Guild: Be an active member of Vinted’s 40+ member AE Guild, benefiting from shared tooling, engineering standards, and knowledge across domains. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to “side quests” that improve engineering practices, tooling, and reusable capabilities.

About you 

  • Experience working as an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or in a closely related data role.
  • Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals, with the ability to build clean, performant, and maintainable data solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt or a similar data transformation framework, building well-structured and tested data models.
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar.
  • A solid understanding of data modelling principles and their application to real-world analytical problems.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar.
  • Comfortable working with high-volume, business-critical data, balancing a high bar for quality and reliability with a pragmatic bias for action.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance [[DELETE FOR Breda, Utrecht, Amsterdam Store]]
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€53.900—€72.900 EUR

Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics. Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management supports the Senior Director in leading the full scope of global clinical supply chain responsibilities.   • Serves as a delegate for the Senior Director in cross-functional forums, governance meetings, supplier reviews and issue escalation, providing clear recommendations and ensuring timely follow-through.

  • Drives operational excellence by defining standard work, governance routines, KPIs and dashboards; uses trend and root-cause analysis to improve service, quality, cost, compliance and team productivity
  • Leads continuous-improvement initiatives that streamline and harmonize processes, strengthen inspection readiness and embed sustainable ways of working
  • Supports regulatory submissions, audits and inspections and ensures timely management of SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs within the function
  • Provides continuity of leadership and performs other responsibilities within the function as assigned

  • Demonstrated success leading complex international clinical studies and product supply chains, with broad knowledge of regulatory and GMP requirements for IMP and commercial product packaging and supply
  • Prior people-management experience, including setting objectives, coaching performance, developing talent, delegating effectively and managing through others
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executable priorities, operating rhythms, metrics and measurable team outcomes
  • Strong operational-excellence and continuous-improvement capability, including process standardization, KPI management, root-cause analysis and sustainable implementation of improvements
  • Solid understanding of IXRS design specifications, set-up and UAT, together with proficiency in clinical supply planning and forecasting tools
  • Strong project, budget, risk and resource-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality results
  • Expertise in outsourcing, supplier governance, negotiation and performance management
  • Experience building, scaling or improving end-to-end product supply chains and associated business processes
  • Ability to operate as a trusted deputy to the Director, exercise sound judgement within delegated authority and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations
  • Confident communicator able to influence all levels of the organization and build effective relationships with global colleagues, customers and suppliers
  • Able to work independently with complex global problems while fostering inclusion, collaboration, accountability and effective team leadership
  • Agile and resilient in a dynamic organization where priorities may change rapidly
  • Knowledge of the drug development process and applicable FDA, EMA and PMDA expectations, including GMP, GCP, Annex 13 and relevant clinical trial requirements
  • Technically proficient with industry-standard systems and tools and able to use technology, data and industry trends to improve efficiency and decision-making
  • Knowledgeable of and compliant with SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs

description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role This is a hands-on research role in our biology and production team. You'll work on the science that underpins everything Adaptyv does: developing and optimizing protein expression systems, running molecular biology workflows, and pushing the boundaries of what we can produce and characterize at scale. We express proteins at high volume across cell-free and cell-based systems, run DNA synthesis and assembly at high throughput, and characterize binding, stability, and function using BLI, SPR, and enzymatic assays. What you'll do Develop and optimize protein expression workflows - cell-free expression (PURE, lysate-based), E. coli, and potentially mammalian systems. Troubleshoot when proteins don't express, misfold, or aggregate. Design and execute DNA synthesis and assembly protocols: PCR, Golden Gate, Gibson. Improve yield, fidelity, and throughput. Develop new assays or adapt existing ones for the platform - thermostability, developability, enzyme activity, or whatever the next customer need demands. Run experiments yourself. This is not a project management role. You'll be at the bench doing molecular biology, analyzing data, and iterating on protocols. Work with the automation team to translate your methods into automated workflows. You develop the protocol that works; they make the robots run it. Analyze experimental data, identify failure modes, and improve methods systematically. When 20% of constructs in a batch fail to express, you figure out why. What we're looking for MSc or PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related field. Hands-on depth matters most - years at the bench doing real molecular biology counts more than the degree title. Practical protein expression and purification skills. You've expressed recombinant proteins and know what it takes to get them soluble, folded, and functional. Experience with DNA synthesis, cloning, or assembly methods (PCR, Golden Gate, Gibson). High-throughput experience is a plus. Comfortable with data analysis - you interpret chromatograms, binding curves, and expression gels without hand-holding. Rigorous experimentalist. You keep detailed notes, design proper controls, and understand why reproducibility matters when you're running hundreds of experiments a month. Interested in automation. You don't need to program robots, but you should want your protocols to become automated workflows rather than staying manual forever. Independent and resourceful. You troubleshoot using literature, first principles, and experimentation - not by waiting for someone to tell you what to try next. Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site - this is a lab role). Client Analytics & Growth Insights

Business Performance Analytics & Reporting

Process Improvement, Automation & Data Enablement

Leadership Reporting & Communications

IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES

description: At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact. Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly! Data Enablement Officer Help shape how Efficio uses data responsibly, securely and effectively. We are looking for a Data Enablement Officer to establish and lead Efficio’s data governance framework, helping us protect client data while enabling its responsible use across our services, analytics, products and AI capabilities. This is a highly visible role at the intersection of data, technology, AI, risk and client delivery. You will work across the business to turn complex contractual, regulatory, privacy and security requirements into practical guidance that enables teams to innovate with confidence. Initially, the role will have a strong advisory and enablement focus: helping teams understand client requirements, assess new uses of data and make proportionate, risk-based decisions. As our governance model matures, the role is expected to take greater ownership of the framework and delegated authority for lower-risk decisions. What you'll be doing Establish our data governance framework You will assess our current data-handling practices and develop a practical, scalable governance framework covering the lifecycle of client data – from collection and classification through to access, use, sharing, storage, retention and secure deletion. You will develop and maintain policies and standards covering areas including: Client data handling and classification Data reuse and fair usage Use of client data within Efficio products Use of data with AI tools, including third-party and self-hosted solutions Data access and security Retention, archiving and secure disposal Anonymisation and aggregation Third-party data sharing Policy exceptions and escalation You will also help establish and maintain our information asset inventories, data flows and AI asset registers. Enable responsible use of data and AI A key part of the role will be helping teams determine what we can do with data, under what conditions, and with what safeguards. You will establish a consistent approach for assessing new and changing data use cases, considering factors such as: Why the data was originally obtained Client and contractual restrictions Data sensitivity and classification The proposed use and intended recipients Security and access controls Retention requirements Legal, client and reputational considerations For AI use cases, you will help define which activities are permitted, restricted, require additional review or are prohibited. This will include the use of prompts, uploaded files and connected data sources, as well as expectations around human oversight, output validation and accountability. Govern products, platforms and technology You will define the conditions under which client data can be stored or processed using Efficio products, SaaS platforms, cloud services and AI tools. Working closely with Technology, Information Security, Legal and Privacy teams, you will assess areas including: Data residency and international transfers Encryption, access controls and logging Supplier and subcontractor access Data retention, backups and deletion Exit and data-export arrangements Use of customer data for AI model training, product improvement or other secondary purposes You will help ensure that unapproved platforms are not used for client data without appropriate assessment and documented approval. Support new solutions and innovation You will work alongside teams designing and deploying new data, software, analytics and AI solutions, providing governance input from an early stage. Ahead of launch, you will help confirm that the appropriate governance, legal, privacy and security reviews have taken place and that material risks have been appropriately addressed. Where issues remain, you will recommend practical remediation, escalation or, where necessary, a delay to rollout. Acceptance of significant residual risk will remain with the appropriate executive or governance committee. Build governance that works in practice This role isn't simply about writing policies. We want to create a governance model that teams can understand and use. You will help develop: A clear data governance operating model and decision-rights framework Practical data, AI, security, reuse and retention policies Data and AI use-case assessment processes Risk-classification and escalation models Policy exception processes and decision registers Product and AI platform assessment standards Solution launch-readiness checklists Training, guidance and supporting materials Governance reporting for senior leadership and relevant committees You will coordinate, advise and constructively challenge stakeholders across the organisation while recognising that responsibility for managing data risk is shared across business owners, data owners, Legal and Privacy, Information Security, Technology and senior governance forums. Client engagement This will also be an important client-facing role. You will participate in client discussions where required, confidently explaining Efficio's approach to data governance, security and responsible data use. You should be comfortable responding to questions about how client data is accessed, used, stored, shared, retained and protected, translating technical or governance concepts into clear, credible explanations for different audiences. What we're looking for We are looking for someone with experience across one or more of the following areas: Data governance or data management Data privacy Information security Technology or operational risk AI governance or responsible AI You will also bring a practical understanding of modern technology environments, including SaaS, cloud, analytics and AI platforms. You'll be someone who can operate comfortably between policy and practice – able to understand complex requirements while recognising the commercial and operational realities of a consulting and technology-enabled business. In particular, you will be able to: Translate complex regulatory, contractual and security requirements into practical business guidance Apply proportionate, risk-based judgement rather than relying on a purely rules-based approach Influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively Work effectively across Technology, Security, Legal, Privacy and business teams Balance commercial objectives and innovation with appropriate governance Communicate confidently with clients and senior internal stakeholders Build processes and frameworks that are robust without creating unnecessary bureaucracy Navigate emerging areas where the answer may not always be immediately clear What success looks like Success in this role will mean that teams understand how to use data appropriately rather than simply being told what they cannot do. We will look at measures including adoption of priority policies, review turnaround times, reduction in unapproved tool usage, effective management of exceptions, quality of governance reporting, stakeholder feedback and a reduction in recurring governance issues. Ultimately, the role will be judged on its ability to achieve both sides of our data ambition: protecting our clients and Efficio while enabling appropriate, secure and innovative use of data and AI. description:
Capco France recherche des Data Engineers pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de plateformes et solutions data modernes, robustes et évolutives.

Au sein de notre Practice Data & Analytics, vous interviendrez sur des projets de transformation à fort impact, de la conception des architectures et pipelines de données jusqu’à leur mise en production et leur optimisation.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données robustes et évolutifs permettant d’ingérer, transformer et mettre à disposition des données issues de sources multiples.
  • Participer à la conception et à l’évolution d’architectures data modernes, notamment dans des environnements Cloud, en tenant compte des enjeux de performance, de sécurité et de scalabilité.
  • Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et l’observabilité des données grâce à des pratiques de tests, monitoring, documentation et automatisation.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Data, Cloud, Architecture et métiers afin de transformer les besoins fonctionnels en solutions techniques performantes et maintenables.
  • Utiliser de manière responsable les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés pour accélérer le développement, les tests, la documentation ou l’analyse des incidents, avec revue humaine et respect des standards de sécurité et de gouvernance

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Une expérience significative en Data Engineering, minimum 5 ans, avec une bonne maîtrise de Python et SQL et une expérience dans la conception de pipelines de données.
  • Une expérience des technologies et architectures data modernes, ainsi que d’au moins un environnement Cloud tel qu’AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Une bonne compréhension des problématiques de modélisation, transformation, qualité et gouvernance des données.
  • Une capacité à collaborer avec des profils techniques et métiers, à résoudre des problématiques complexes et à communiquer clairement les choix techniques.
  • Une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled appliqués au Data Engineering, avec une attention portée à la sécurité, à la qualité, à la traçabilité et à la validation humaine.
  • Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements complexes, réglementés et internationaux, avec une excellente communication en français et en anglais.

Atouts supplémentaires

  • Une expérience avec des technologies telles que Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka ou dbt.

  • Une expérience dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux, l’assurance ou plus largement les services financiers.
  • Une connaissance des problématiques de sécurité, gouvernance, lineage et protection des données dans des environnements réglementés.
  • Une expérience pratique de l’utilisation de Generative AI ou Agentic AI pour améliorer des workflows d’ingénierie, avec des mécanismes appropriés de revue, contrôle et traçabilité.

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco ? 

 

Créé en 1998, Capco est un cabinet de conseil en management et en organisation spécialisé dans le secteur des services financiers, avec 34 bureaux répartis entre l’Amérique, l’Asie et l’Europe et regroupant 7 000 collaborateurs dont 160 à Paris.

Notre offre conseil s’appuie sur trois grands domaines d’expertise : Business Consulting, Digital et Techonology

Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :

  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance

  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :
    • #BeYourselfAtWork

    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles

Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.

This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.

We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.

  • Deep power systems expertise

  • Origination and senior client leadership
  • Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes

You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.

Key Responsibilities

Power Systems & Grid Transformation

  • Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.
  • Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.

Origination & Growth

  • Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor high-performing teams.
  • Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.

Essential Experience

  • Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy
  • Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory
  • Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.
  • Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.
  • Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.
  • Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.
  • Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.

Core Capabilities

  • Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.
  • Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.
  • Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.
  • Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform.
  • Experience with digital, AI, or advanced analytical tools that improve insight generation, modelling, or delivery efficiency.
  • Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships.

Mindset

  • Entrepreneurial and opportunity-driven.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and building new areas of work.
  • Collaborative, low ego, and mission-driven.
  • Pragmatic, intellectually rigorous, and focused on real-world impact.

Why This Role Matters

Power systems are now one of the central constraints in the energy transition. Renewables, electrification, storage, flexibility, industrial decarbonisation, and clean technology deployment all depend on power systems evolving faster than they are today.

This role sits at the centre of that challenge. It will help clients and partners address the grid, market, regulatory, and institutional barriers that determine whether economy-wide decarbonisation can happen at the pace required.

description: Health can’t wait. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices. ⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs. Why is this segment interesting? Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support. Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics; Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness; HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies) Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs. Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters. What will you do with us? You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies. At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless. We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base. Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀 ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for? You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you: Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English. Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills; Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems; Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building; Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models; Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team; Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1; Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range. If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France. Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport. Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture. Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description:
Joining Capco means joining an organization that is committed to an inclusive working environment where you’re encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We celebrate individuality and recognize that diversity and inclusion, in all forms, is critical to success. It’s important to us that we recruit and develop as diverse a range of talent as we can and we believe that everyone brings something different to the table – so we’d love to know what makes you different. Such differences may mean we need to make changes to our process to allow you the best possible platform to succeed, and we are happy to cater to any reasonable adjustments you may require. You will find the section to let us know of these at the bottom of your application form or you can mention it directly to your recruiter at any stage and they will be happy to help.

About Capco

Capco is a global technology and management consultancy dedicated to the financial services industry. We combine innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge, to offer our clients consulting expertise, complex technology and package integration, transformation delivery and managed services to move their organizations forward.

  • We specialize primarily in banking & payments, capital markets, wealth & asset management, insurance and energy
  • We have a collaborative and efficient approach
  • We help our clients successfully innovate, increase revenue, manage risk and regulatory change, reduce costs and enhance controls
  • We serve our clients from 32 offices across the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific

If creativity and innovation are your passion, then Capco is right for you. You can grow in an inclusive, diverse and collaborative environment. At Capco, we will train and support you to help accelerate your career. 

 

The Role

As a Finance Data Engineer at Capco, you will work at the intersection of IT, Data and Finance, supporting the evolution of a critical Finance Data Mart used for Business Finance information, MI and reporting in Private Banking as well as other Banking areas. 

The platform is a key source of financial information, supporting measures including such as Assets under Management (AuM), Net New Money (NNM) and Return on Assets (RoA) and other KPIs.  

You will combine technical and data expertise with Finance understanding, enabling you to interpret and validate financial outputs, identify issues and help improve the quality and capabilities of the platform. 

 

 

YOUR CAPCO DAY 

  • Work on the enhancement, upgrade, and potential re-development of a critical Finance Data Mart and its underlying data capabilities. 
  • Analyse and work with Business Finance data used to produce MI and reporting, including measures such as AuM, NNM and RoA and other critical KPIs in Private Banking. 
  • Use your Finance understanding to test and validate data outputs, identify inconsistencies, and ensure that information produced by the platform makes sense from a Business Finance perspective. 
  • Work closely with IT, Data and Finance stakeholders to translate Finance requirements into robust data and technical solutions. 
  • Contribute as part of a global team to improve the quality, reliability and future capabilities of a critical source of Business Finance information. 

 

 

 

YOUR CAPCO-FIT 

 

 

  • Deep experience in Data and IT, with strong database knowledge and hands-on SQL skills, alongside an understanding of coding and data engineering concepts. 
  • A strong understanding of Finance that enables you to interpret financial information, understand Business Finance reporting, and critically assess the outputs produced from underlying data. 
  • The ability to bridge Data, IT and Finance, translating between technical implementation and the financial meaning and purpose of the information being produced. 
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to test and validate outputs, investigate discrepancies, identify errors and recommend improvements. 
  • Professional proficiency in English, as you will work within a global team where English is the working language. 

 

BONUS POINTS FOR 

  • Professional proficiency in French. 
  • Experience with Finance Data Marts, management information or Business Finance reporting within banking or financial services. 
  • Knowledge of private banking metrics and measures such as Assets under Management (AuM), Net New Money (NNM) and Return on Assets (RoA). 
  • Experience working with data environments supporting core banking platforms. 
  • Experience contributing to the enhancement, migration or re-development of complex data platforms. 

 

WHY CAPCO

A career at Capco is a chance to help reshape the competitive landscape in financial services. We launch new banks, transform existing ones, and help our clients navigate complex change. As consultants, we work on the front-end business design all the way through to technology implementation.

We are the largest Financial Services focused consultancy in the world, serving everyone from global banks to emerging FinTechs, from strategy through digital transformation, design, business consulting, data and analytics, cyber, cloud, technology architecture, and engineering.

Capco is a young and growing firm. We maintain an entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset, and have minimal bureaucracy. We have no internal silos that get in the way of your career opportunities or ability to focus on our clients and make a difference to the business. We offer the opportunity for everyone to learn rapidly, take on tough challenges, and get promoted quickly. We take pride in our creative, collaborative, diverse, and inclusive culture, where everyone can #BYAW.

We offer highly competitive benefits, flexible working hours, technical and soft skills training, smartphone & fast mobile internet and a work culture focused on innovation and creation of lasting value for our clients and employees.

 

Ready to take the Next Step 

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.  This is an opportunity to make a difference and contribute to a highly successful company with a significant growth trajectory.

description: About EHG EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide. Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company. The opportunity We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas. You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that. Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets. Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US. What you'll own One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland. Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one. In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment. Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves. Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria. Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other. Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities. Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant. Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly. Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow. What we're looking for Core experience Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance. Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one. Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability. Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard. Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects. Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage. The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure. Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely. Especially compelling Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience. Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes. Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end. Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators. Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth. Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required. What we offer Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you. Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland. The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth. description: About EHG EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide. Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company. The opportunity We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas. You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that. Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets. Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US. What you'll own One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland. Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one. In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment. Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves. Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria. Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other. Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities. Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant. Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly. Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow. What we're looking for Core experience Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance. Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one. Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability. Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard. Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects. Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage. The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure. Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely. Especially compelling Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience. Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes. Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end. Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators. Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth. Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required. What we offer Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you. Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland. The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth. Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States. EH Group is an equal opportunity employer.
