Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux. Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE. Le poste Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais. Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients. Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise. Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements). Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production. Vos missions Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression. Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression. Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces. Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production. Mise au point et validation Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire. Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence. Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main. Documentation et propriété intellectuelle Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais. Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau). Vie du laboratoire Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins. Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001. Requirements Compétences techniques Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO. Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure. Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques. Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Savoir-être Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout. Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais. Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements. Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées. Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure. Formation et expérience Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés. Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus. Benefits Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique. description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

You will work with a team of engineers, as well as different departments and functions, to accomplish your goals and achieve our vision.

Your responsibilities will mainly focus on French warehouses in Paris, Lyon, Lille and future locations IT infrastructure and onsite support services (workstations, network,warehouse IT hardware i.e. handheld devices / scanners / label printers, servers, ), with frequent business trips to our locations across France and possibly Europe and remote support for them.

Please note that this role requires you to work on-site in Vinted's warehouse 3 to 4 days a week.

  • Manage the lifecycle of IT Hardware equipment across Vinted Go locations across France and Europe: procurement, replacement, repairs, and disposal.

  • Support colleagues via ticketing system and internal communication tools on hardware and services-related topics
  • Work together with the team to build roadmaps for your area
  • Create valuable processes and procedures to help be more efficient, automate dull work
  • Handle daily operational activities, spare time for knowledge management and documentation
  • Co-create together with different teams, stakeholders, and suppliers to improve our services and implement solutions

About you 

  • Have good understanding of IT hardware and software
  • Have basic knowledge in Networks (WiFi, LAN)

  • You are comfortable traveling across France and Europe for business needs
  • Located near Marseille area, as position is mostly on site

  • Working with vendors and stakeholders is in your comfort zone
  • You are willing to help our colleagues with their IT struggles
  • Uncertainty is your motivation rather than a challenge
  • You are willing to learn and support your colleagues in their growth
  • You have great written and in-person communication skills

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Co-contribution meal vouchers for each workday through a convenient meal card
  • Comprehensive Medical Coverage
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Equal opportunity

The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one. In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment. Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves. Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria. Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other. Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities. Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant. Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly. Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end. Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators. Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit. Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties. Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. description: At ONI, we are driven by a profound mission: to propel scientific discovery and combat diseases by granting everyone the ability to visualize, comprehend, and share the intricate microscopic details of life. Our revolutionary Nanoimager and Aplo Platform stand at the forefront of advancing cellular studies on a molecular level, making substantial contributions to the evolution of scientific knowledge. We’re looking for a product manager to own our kits and workflows, including EV Profiler and LNP Profiler, now that the concept is proven. You’ll make sure sample preparation, fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software work together as one system, and your responsibility is the complete customer experience, from sample to scientifically meaningful result. The job is making that system rock solid: hardening what’s already on the market, making sure it works the same way at every site, and getting more customers on it without support load growing at the same rate. The Role As part of the Product team, you’ll own the product management of our kits and end-to-end workflows, including the Discovery Kit, EV Profiler and LNP Profiler and their future revisions. You will ensure these work together with automated sample preparation and fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software to deliver reliable, reproducible and intuitive solutions for our customers. The initial products have launched, and the work now is making them dependable, repeatable, and scalable for our customers. You’ll create clarity and momentum for the R&D teams by understanding which problems matter, turning customer and market evidence into priorities, and removing barriers to delivering a coherent solution. You’ll grow adoption to routine use across many sites, including bioprocessing and QC settings where results must be reproducible and defensible, and you’ll work with Marketing on positioning and the product story as the portfolio evolves. You will play a critical role in bringing these quality improvements to the market and ensuring that current and future kits maintain their quality over time, and you’ll help define the roadmap for next iterations of existing and future kits and workflows. As a product manager, you’ll be the connective tissue between software, hardware, bioware, support, and the field, acting as the voice of the customer to help internal teams better understand our customers’ needs and problems. The role is ideal for a technically curious, commercially aware individual who loves getting hands-on with products, takes ownership of outcomes and thrives on complex, cross-functional challenges. You will work broadly across our platform and alongside US colleagues; the position is based in Oxford and involves occasional travel to customers and our US team (typically 10-20%). What you’ll do Understand scientists and their complete workflows first-hand. Work with customers and field teams, study usage and support data, and synthesize their sometimes conflicting inputs into the problems worth solving. Drive evidence-led product direction and priorities across our solutions with R&D and commercial leaders, balancing customer outcomes, differentiation, adoption, reliability, margin and technical feasibility. Own the roadmap for our kits (including the Discovery Kit and the EV and LNP Profiler kits) and workflows, balancing quality, reliability, usability and new features. Build and refine market and product requirements (MRD/PRD) across workflows, from sample preparation (Aplo Flow) through acquisition (Aplo Scope) to analysis (CODI), according to our Product Development Process. Own validation for each kit and workflow: define acceptance criteria, performance specifications and validation plans, including reference samples and reproducibility across instruments, operators and sites. Work with R&D, who own development and verification. Drive coherence across our end-to-end solutions, ensuring kits, reagents, lab automation, instruments and software evolve together rather than as disconnected products. Champion reproducibility, usability and reliable results across the complete workflow. Connect R&D, operations, quality, service, field applications, sales, marketing and customers. Establish feedback loops, clear ownership and effective cross-team decisions. Own pricing and packaging for our kits and workflows, balancing customer value, competitiveness and margin targets. Work with Marketing throughout a product's life to shape positioning, the value proposition and the product story as the portfolio evolves, not only at launch. Lead launch and release planning with R&D, Marketing and the field: set readiness criteria, make go/no-go decisions, and coordinate documentation, release notes and training for each launch or revision. Create and run webinars and internal training for the field application and sales teams on new products and revisions, and keep an accurate record of what each kit, instrument and software version can deliver. Track post-launch performance, including adoption, kit reorders, time to first result, reproducibility, support burden, customer feedback and commercial results, and use it to set priorities. Analyze support tickets, logs and customer feedback to identify recurring failure modes, and prioritize root-cause fixes into the roadmap. Work with Quality and Operations on manufacturing transfer, life cycle support and end of life, so our kits and workflows maintain quality over time. What you’ll bring A life-science background, ideally EVs, LNPs, nanoparticle characterization, imaging or biophysics. Being able to speak the language of our customers is critical. An MSc/PhD or equivalent hands-on experience is a real plus. Fluency across software, instruments, laboratory workflows and multidisciplinary R&D; comfortable investigating issues hands-on and understanding how the system fits together. Experience working with empowered, cross-functional development teams: knowing when to provide context, decide on a trade-off and leave the solution to specialists. Product management (or product owner) experience in life-science tools or instrumentation, ideally taking something from first release to a scaled, supported product. Experience planning and running launches with Marketing, R&D and the field, from development through adoption. Commercial and pricing judgement: You can weigh customer value, competitiveness and margin when setting price and packaging. A quality mindset: You’re comfortable writing acceptance criteria and test plans, and you think about risk, reproducibility and traceability. Exposure to a quality system (ISO 9001 or 13485) is a plus. Comfort with data: logs, tickets, precision and method-comparison numbers (CVs, site to site). Evidence sets priorities, not the loudest voice. The ability to lead across software, hardware, bioware, support and field without owning any of them, and to prioritize when everything feels urgent. Clear writing and organization skills. Requirements, release notes and docs that other people can act on. Nice to have Super-resolution or single-molecule imaging experience (dSTORM, PALM, DNA-PAINT), or general microscopy experience (TIRF, widefield, confocal, spinning-disk). Hands-on EV or LNP work in research, biopharma, gene therapy or drug delivery. Laboratory automation, automated liquid handling, sample preparation, consumable kits, workflow integration, scientific software or data analysis. Integrating instruments, software, consumables and automated lab workflows; exposure to verification, validation, quality systems or lifecycle support. Commercialization, pricing, segmentation, product positioning or product marketing in technically sophisticated markets. As an equal opportunity employer, we prioritize fairness and respect, ensuring every team member thrives regardless of their background. Private Healthcare and Dental Coverage: Your health matters to us. Access top-notch medical and dental services, ensuring your well-being is in good hands. People’s Pension: Secure your future with our pension scheme, investing in your financial well-being beyond the workplace. description: Worum gehts? Event Inc stellt sich als AI-First-Plattform für Events, Meetings und Hotels neu auf, und dafür braucht es eine klare Stimme. Als Product Marketing & Brand Lead bestimmst Du, wie wir uns positionieren und wie unsere Marke bei Kunden, Partnern und Investoren wirkt. Du berichtest an unseren CRO und arbeitest eng mit unserem Content-, SEO- & GEO-Manager sowie unserem Data Analyst (Go-to-Market & Insights) zusammen. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest unsere Positionierung und unseren Markenauftritt, von der Kernbotschaft unserer AI-First-Story bis zur Konsistenz über alle Kanäle. Du gibst die Richtung vor und erteilst die Freigaben, die Content-, SEO- & GEO-Rolle setzt um. Positionierung & Produkt-Story: Du gibst die Richtung für unsere AI-First-Story und unser Produktportfolio vor. Die KI liefert Entwürfe, Du schärfst sie und gibst sie frei. Marke mit Wiedererkennungswert: Du verantwortest unsere Markenidentität und sorgst für einen konsistenten Auftritt gegenüber Kunden, Partnern und Investoren. Story nach außen tragen: Du übersetzt Marken- und Produktstory in die externe Kommunikation, z. B. beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege unserer Homepage-Story. Content mit Plan: Du entwickelst Content-Ideen, Strategie und Planung und beantwortest die Frage, was wir wann und wo kommunizieren. Auch für Newsletter und Marketing Automation lieferst Du den Story- und Portfolio-Input. Sales stark machen: Du unterstützt bei Pitch-Decks, Battlecards und RFP/RFI-Antworten. Die Begleitung unserer Go-to-Market-Aktivitäten gehört für Dich ganz selbstverständlich dazu. Eigene Events & MICE Report: Du verantwortest Konzept und Ownership unserer Kunden- und Branchenformate. Beim MICE Report hast Du die Projektleitung und sorgst dafür, dass er bei C-Level und in der PR ankommt. Die Redaktion liegt bei Content, SEO & GEO. Datenbasiert entscheiden: Du formulierst gezielte Analyse-Anfragen an unseren Data Analyst und übersetzt die Empfehlungen in GTM-Entscheidungen. Mitgestalten auf Führungsebene: Du wirkst bei der Team-Priorisierung mit und stimmst Dich direkt mit CRO und CEO ab. Was uns gefällt Erfahrung, die zählt: Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Marketing oder in einer vergleichbaren Positionierungs- oder Brand-Rolle mit, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld. Enterprise-Know-how: Du hast Erfahrung im Produkt- und Salesmarketing für komplexe Enterprise-Zielgruppen und kennst Procurement-Prozesse. Erfahrung mit RFP/RFI-Prozessen ist ein Plus. Storytelling im Blut: Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Geschichten und Marken und weißt, wie man komplexe Produkte greifbar macht. Markenführung mit System: Du sorgst für Konsistenz von Ton, visueller Identität und Botschaften über mehrere Touchpoints und Websites hinweg. Mit Marken-KPIs wie Awareness, Sentiment und Preference kennst Du Dich in den Grundzügen aus. Den Markt im Blick: Wettbewerbsanalyse und Competitive Intelligence gehören für Dich zum Arbeitsalltag. Tool-sicher: Du bist mit Marketing-Automation-Tools wie HubSpot vertraut. Souverän auf jeder Ebene: Du trittst sicher auf und hast Erfahrung darin, Senior- und Exec-Level wie CRO und CEO zu beraten und vor ihnen zu präsentieren. Macher-Mentalität: Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und fühlst Dich in einem kleinen Team wohl. Was Dir gefällt Teamspirit, der Spaß macht: Freu Dich auf ein motiviertes, hochqualifiziertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Zusammenhalt. Dazu gibt's regelmäßige Teamevents wie Afterwork-Drinks auf der Dachterrasse, Culture Nights oder Spieleabende. Sei ein Sparfuchs: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf Top-Marken und Reisen über PepXpress und Corporate Benefits. Gut versorgt: Natürlich stehen Dir der obligatorische Obstkorb, eine Müslibar sowie kalte und warme Getränke jederzeit zur Verfügung. Individuelle Hardware-Wahl: Du entscheidest, ob Du mit einem Mac oder einem Windows-Gerät arbeitest. Arbeitszeiten: Unsere Kernarbeitszeit ist von 10 bis 17 Uhr. Pick your Perk: Du wählst 20 € Benefitsy, 20 € Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder 20 € Zuschuss für Urban Sports. Wachstum: Wir fördern Deine Weiterentwicklung mit einem Learning Budget von 300 € pro Jahr. Für später schon heute gesorgt: Du bekommst bis zu 100 € monatlich für Deine Altersvorsorge und Vermögensziele (bAV & VWL). description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role This is not a lab technician position. This is a senior scientist who owns assay quality, data QC and controls, and production troubleshooting across the entire experimental pipeline. The production team runs 150+ experiments per month across expression, BLI, SPR, thermostability, and enzyme activity. When something goes wrong (failed expression, anomalous binding data, instrument artifacts), this person diagnoses the root cause and fixes it. As the assay and instrumentation portfolio expands, this person translates new R&D methods into production-ready protocols, builds robust methods that junior technicians can execute reliably, and designs comprehensive controls that enable automated QC and data processing. This is a player-coach position. You will still run experiments personally, especially as you integrate into the lab, but you will also elevate the whole team's capabilities. What You'll Do Troubleshoot production failures across the full pipeline. A batch of proteins isn't expressing: is it the construct design, the expression system, or the media? BLI sensorgrams look noisy: is it the sensor tips, the sample prep, or an instrument issue? You figure it out, fix it, and make the cause easier to identify next time. Develop and document SOPs for new assays as the portfolio expands. Take methods from the R&D team and make them production-ready: robust, reproducible, and executable by junior technicians without hand-holding. Mentor a growing production team. Set quality standards, review data, train new hires, and build a culture where people flag problems early instead of hiding them. Work at the intersection of biology, automation, and QC. Collaborate with researchers, laboratory technicians, and automation engineers on protocol optimization for work cells, and with software on LabOS protocol integration. Own the relationship between assay science and throughput. The easy version of every assay doesn't scale, and the scalable version often sacrifices quality. You find the right tradeoff. What We're Looking For Deep hands-on expertise in protein production: expression (E. coli, mammalian, cell-free), purification (IMAC, SEC), and biophysical characterization (BLI and SPR at minimum). This isn't negotiable. You need to have done this work yourself, at volume. PhD in protein biochemistry, biophysics, or structural biology, plus 3-5 years in a production or development role at a CRO, foundry, or high-throughput lab. Academic postdocs count if the work was high-throughput and production-oriented. Experience with high-throughput workflows. You're comfortable with 96-well plates and liquid handlers, not just single-column purifications. You've optimized protocols for scale, not just for one perfect result. Mentorship mindset. You've managed or trained junior scientists before. You enjoy teaching and get satisfaction from watching your team grow. Troubleshooting instinct. When data looks wrong, your first impulse is to understand why, not to rerun the experiment and hope it works. Quality-obsessed but pragmatic. You care deeply about data quality, but you also understand that production has deadlines and sometimes "good enough" is the right call. Bridge between R&D and production. You can speak both languages: the exploratory mindset of research and the reproducibility demands of production. description: Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk. We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural. Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie. Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf. Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken, of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. Over de functie De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand. Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS. Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat. De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team. Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat. Wat je gaat doen De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project. Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers. Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge. Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren. Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators. Wat we zoeken Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder. Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie. Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden. Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen. Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren. Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen. Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. description: About EHG EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide. Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company. The opportunity We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas. You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that. Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets. Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US. What you'll own One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland. Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one. In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment. Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves. Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria. Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other. Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities. Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant. Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly. Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow. What we're looking for Core experience Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance. Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one. Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability. Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard. Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects. Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage. The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure. Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely. Especially compelling Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience. Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes. Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end. Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators. Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth. Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required. What we offer Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you. Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland. The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth. Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States. EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. description: About EHG EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide. Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company. The opportunity We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas. You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that. Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets. Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US. What you'll own One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland. Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one. In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment. Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves. Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria. Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other. Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities. Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant. Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly. Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow. What we're looking for Core experience Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance. Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one. Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability. Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard. Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects. Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage. The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure. Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely. Especially compelling Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience. Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes. Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end. Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators. Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth. Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required. What we offer Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you. Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland. The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth. Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States. EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. Your job is to take expression and purification from bespoke, person-dependent protocols to a robust, automated, high-throughput product. You'll optimize and run the science hands-on, work with lab automation to scale it onto liquid handlers and automated systems, and work with the software team to track samples, capture process data, and make production observable and predictable. You'll lead the science and stay deeply hands-on. What You'll Do Develop, optimize, and run mammalian expression hands-on (CHO/HEK, transient and stable), pushing titer, quality, and reproducibility. Own purification across modalities (Protein A, IEX, SEC, and related) and the quality of the proteins we ship. Turn expression and purification into a productized, high-throughput, automated capability with predictable turnaround. Partner with lab automation to scale workflows onto automated systems, and reduce manual, person-dependent steps. Work with the software team to track samples and process parameters, and make production yields and quality observable and improvable. Set the quality bar and troubleshoot the inevitable failures across biology, reagents, and process. What We're Looking For Deep, hands-on expertise in mammalian protein expression and purification — CHO/HEK, and the full path from construct to purified, characterized protein. Applied industry experience. You've run expression and purification in a production or industrial setting — where yield, reproducibility, and turnaround mattered at scale — not primarily in an academic research project. This is the core requirement. Track record of making production reliable — titer optimization, scale-up, and consistent quality, not one-off preps. Builder who moves fast. You want to stand up and continuously improve a production capability, not run a fixed protocol. Interdisciplinary. You collaborate naturally with automation engineers and software people, and you see automation and data as core to a modern production process. Data fluency (scripting, tracking and analyzing process data) is a strong plus. Review final creative placements across Meta and LinkedIn to ensure assets display correctly on paid channels. People Management & Leadership Direct Management: Line manage, mentor, and foster career growth for a cross-functional team of three in-house designers and one copywriter overseeing their daily priorities and bandwidth. Stakeholder Alignment & Strategy Cross-Functional Partner: Serve as the strategic operational bridge connecting the studio with Marketing, Events, HR/People Ops, and Legal. Leadership Alignment: Work closely with the Director of Brand Strategy & Experience and Associate Director of Brand Management to align studio output with broader brand goals and business priorities. Solid background working in-house in a fast-paced brand function (tech, scale-up, or high-growth environment). Direct people management of the studio team is a core part of this role. Set best practice for how the studio takes in, briefs, tracks and resources work. Improve how we estimate and plan capacity, using AI where it makes sense. Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Our team’s mission is to align Vinted’s values, business goals, and Employer Value Proposition with our people’s real work experience. We translate Vinted’s truth into an inspiring story that attracts the right people, helps them grow, and instils them with pride.

You’ll take an active role in Employer Branding at Vinted, with a particular focus on attracting engineering and data science talent. You’ll be based in Amsterdam, where our data science team is growing, but your work will reach candidates around the world.

Vinted has become an ecosystem with vertically integrated shipping and payments. This requires us to adapt our EVP to three very distinct brands and even more diversified hiring needs. Your job is to turn that into creative campaigns and stories that make specific audiences want to work here.

Our next big focus is storytelling. Bringing the skills and challenges our teams face to life! What is a day in the life of a cybersecurity analyst? How does an anti-money laundering expert keep members’ wallets safe? What does it take to build the data science behind a marketplace used by millions? And what stories does each of our locations need?

Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering and data science leaders, People, Marketing, PR, Internal Comms, and Brand & Design, you’ll make sure those stories are told and that our presence is strong where we hire.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Be the guardian of Vinted’s employer brand, ensuring consistency and visibility across all platforms, like LinkedIn and Instagram
  • Strong brand-building skills, with a clear vision of global vs local branding differentiation
  • Use your sound understanding of branding and our editorial guidelines to write clear and engaging copy for things such as blogs, advertising campaigns, employer branding assets, email campaigns, event materials, online company profiles, as well as our careers pages.
  • Create bespoke or support partnership events such as meetups, webinars, and networking events
  • Plan and run recruitment advertising, such as targeted LinkedIn campaigns and sponsorships with third-party publications and organisations, aimed at technical audiences.
  • Define where our global employer brand ends and local adaptation begins, so each location can tell its story while staying consistent with Vinted’s.
  • Shape our content calendar around hiring needs and our location strategy.
  • Track what works, using results to sharpen the next activation, and share learnings with the wider Employer Branding team.

About you 

  • Passionate about all things Employer Branding!
  • You love storytelling: finding stories and having a keen eye for telling them in ways that stand out. You can show campaigns or activations you conceived and delivered.
  • Background in building and nurturing online and offline communities, and delivering innovative events and social media campaigns.
  • A clear view of global vs local branding, and experience working across markets.
  • Adept at identifying new talent attraction channels, especially for engineering and data science audiences.
  • Comfortable using data to set goals and judge what worked.

  • Excited by change, a fast pace, and learning new ways of doing things.

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Hybrid work

Equal opportunity

Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies, and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product. Not ticking every box? Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn’t always follow a checklist and we care more about your potential, curiosity, and motivation to learn. At ACCURIDS, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science, and data to apply. description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Ripple is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Manager to join our Customer Partner Success (CPS) team based in London. As a Senior Manager, you will play a crucial role in maintaining and growing Ripple's existing client base across our diverse range of products and services, including Payments, Custody and Stablecoins. We are a dynamic team within the Sales function that is essential to the success of a customers growth strategy.

The ideal candidate lives and breathes customer centricity, has a passion for the cryptocurrency industry, is meticulous in their analysis, methodical, creative, and thorough in their problem-solving approach, and can easily build and grow relationships with internal and external partners.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the main contact person for Ripple's most valued Enterprise clients, guaranteeing their contentment and addressing any business or customer concerns.
  • Experience managing large enterprise financial insitutions, including Global and Regional Banks, Large Fintechs and Asset Managers.
  • Focus on client retention and satisfaction, developing strategies to assist in their organic growth.
  • Identify up-sell and cross-sell opportunities aligned with Ripple's roadmap.
  • Conduct structured business reviews to assess client needs and provide tailored solutions.
  • Discuss and negotiate contractual and commercial terms with clients.
  • Represent Ripple at industry events when required.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in Account/Relationship management within the Financial Services industry.
  • 3+ years of experience in the Digital Assets and/or payments industry or a related field.
  • Demonstrated track record in identifying and capitalizing on commercial opportunities with established client bases.
  • A deep understanding of blockchain technology and/or traditional financial services.
  • Experience collaborating with decision makers at large financial institutions
  • Ability to consolidate client feedback and disseminate to our Product partners.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present effectively.
  • Additional language skills advantageous.

About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the Role

The Manager, Regional Marketing Operations is responsible for turning global and regional marketing priorities into coordinated, localized, production-ready, and successfully delivered marketing activity across the Region.

This role owns the regional execution layer of the marketing operating model, connecting Regional Marketing with Crunchyroll’s global operational capabilities. The candidate will ensure campaigns are operationally planned, assets are produced and localized to regional requirements, dependencies are managed, and final materials are delivered accurately and on time across relevant regional channels and partners.

A critical responsibility of the role is the end-to-end management of marketing localization for the Region. This includes localization of all marketing assets used regionally, whether those assets originate from a global campaign or are created specifically for a regional initiative. The Manager coordinates translation, transcreation, adaptation, versioning, approvals, quality checks, and delivery of localized marketing materials, working closely with Global Localization while remaining accountable for regional marketing localization readiness.

The role operates as the regional counterpart to Global Operations, Content and Marketing and Distribution Operations, Content and Marketing, with particularly close interfaces to Integrated Planning, Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, and Marketing Delivery. The objective is to leverage common global processes, technology, production capabilities, and standards while ensuring regional priorities, language requirements, cultural considerations, channels, and market-specific needs are fully represented

Key Responsibilities

  • Regional Marketing Operations & Execution: Own the operational coordination of the Region’s marketing activity, translating global and regional marketing strategies into executable plans, milestones, asset requirements, localization needs, dependencies, and delivery schedules. Maintain an integrated view of regional marketing readiness and ensure activities move effectively from planning through execution.
  • Regional Integrated Planning: Partner closely with Integrated Planning to incorporate regional priorities, launches, campaigns, tentpoles, local initiatives, and market requirements into the broader global marketing planning process. Translate global plans into actionable regional timelines while providing early visibility into local requirements, resource constraints, localization lead times, and execution risks.
  • End-to-End Marketing Localization Management: Manage the localization workflow for all global and regional marketing assets required by the Region, including copy, key art, trailers, video, social assets, paid-media creative, CRM materials, partner assets, promotional content, and other campaign deliverables. Coordinate translation, transcreation, cultural adaptation, versioning, review, approvals, QA, and final delivery, ensuring localized assets are accurate, brand-appropriate, culturally relevant, and available against campaign deadlines. Partner with Global Localization on standards, technology, vendors, workflows, terminology, and quality frameworks while retaining operational accountability for regional marketing localization.
  • Marketing Production Coordination: Partner with Marketing Production to communicate regional production and localization requirements early, define necessary versions and formats, and ensure global source assets are structured to enable efficient regional adaptation. Coordinate requests for region-specific materials where global assets do not meet local needs while avoiding unnecessary duplication of global production capabilities. For regionally originated campaigns, manage the operational interface between regional creative requirements and the appropriate production resources.
  • Marketing Delivery Coordination: Work closely with Marketing Delivery within Distribution Operations, Content and Marketing to ensure final global and localized marketing assets are packaged, distributed, and made available to the correct regional destinations on time. Coordinate region-specific channel requirements, specifications, deadlines, and partner needs and provide clear escalation when assets are missing, incorrect, delayed, or unable to meet delivery requirements.
  • Regional Stakeholder & Market Coordination: Partner with Regional Marketing, Content, Social, CRM, Paid Media, Partnerships, Brand, PR, and other local stakeholders to consolidate operational requirements and create one coordinated regional view of campaign execution. Ensure stakeholders have clear visibility into asset availability, localization status, production milestones, delivery readiness, risks, and decisions required.
  • Regional Campaign & Asset Readiness: Establish clear readiness checkpoints for priority campaigns and launches, validating that required source assets, localized versions, formats, approvals, metadata, specifications, and delivery destinations are complete. Identify risks early and coordinate resolution across Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, Global Localization, Marketing Delivery, and regional teams before they impact campaign activation.
  • Regional and Partner-Specific Requirements: Own the operational coordination of marketing requirements unique to the Region, including local platforms, commercial partners, media channels, regulatory considerations, language requirements, cultural adaptations, and market-specific formats. Ensure these requirements are communicated sufficiently early to global teams to allow them to be incorporated efficiently into production and delivery workflows.
  • Operational Issue & Escalation Management: Serve as the regional operational control point when marketing assets, localization, production, or delivery issues threaten campaign execution. Coordinate cross-functional triage, maintain clear accountability through resolution, communicate impact and status to regional stakeholders, and escalate systemic issues to the appropriate global teams.
  • Performance & Continuous Improvement: Track regional marketing operations performance across campaign readiness, on-time asset availability, localization turnaround, production delivery, error rates, rework, and recurring operational issues. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve global-to-regional handoffs, reduce duplicate work, automate repetitive activity, and strengthen the scalability of Crunchyroll’s marketing operating model.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign operations, creative operations, localization, marketing production, media operations, or a related field, ideally within entertainment, streaming, media, technology, or another global consumer business.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-market marketing campaigns with significant dependencies across planning, creative production, localization, asset management, and delivery.
  • Strong understanding of marketing localization, including translation, transcreation, cultural adaptation, asset versioning, review and approval workflows, and the operational requirements associated with delivering localized creative at scale.
  • Experience coordinating both globally originated campaigns and locally originated marketing activity, with the ability to operate effectively between central capabilities and regional business needs.
  • Strong knowledge of marketing production workflows across multiple asset types, including digital, video, social, paid media, CRM, partner marketing, and promotional creative.
  • Proven ability to coordinate across highly matrixed organizations and establish effective working relationships among regional teams and global functions.
  • Excellent project and operational management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, markets, languages, asset types, dependencies, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to identify execution risks early and drive issues through to resolution.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence teams across functions, cultures, and time zones.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to brand consistency, localization quality, executional excellence, and the fan experience.

Preferred

  • Experience within anime, entertainment, streaming, television, gaming, or another global content-led consumer business.
  • Experience managing marketing localization across multiple languages and markets.
  • Familiarity with campaign-management, project-management, digital asset-management, localization-management, and marketing-delivery platforms.
  • Experience working with creative agencies, localization vendors, production partners, media agencies, and external distribution or commercial partners.
  • Demonstrated experience improving marketing workflows through standardization, automation, operational metrics, and root-cause analysis.

description: Jobbeschreibung Du hast die Paid-Social-Landschaft fest im Griff und nutzt KI im Kampagnenmanagement nicht als Hype, sondern als tägliches Werkzeug? Du möchtest datengetriebene Entscheidungen treffen, kreative Kampagnen entwickeln und aktiv mitgestalten, wie modernste AI-Tools Analyse, Reporting und Kreation im E-Commerce revolutionieren? Dann wartet in unserem Team in Berlin deine nächste große Challenge auf dich: Bei benuta übernimmst du echte Ownership für unsere Paid-Social-Kanäle und treibst ein echtes Greenfield-Thema voran – die Skalierung KI-gestützter Analysen, Workflows und Strategien für den europäischen Marktführer im Home-&-Living-Bereich! Deine Aufgaben Strategische Paid-Social-Steuerung: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die kanalübergreifende Paid-Social-Media-Strategie zur Erreichung unserer Unternehmensziele (Brand Awareness, Lead-Gen, Performance-Ziele) und richtest sie an der übergreifenden Marketingstrategie aus. Kampagnenmanagement & Kanal-Synergien: Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstellung, das Monitoring und die Optimierung unserer Paid-Social-Kampagnen (Schwerpunkt Meta, Pinterest, Reddit Ads und TikTok) und arbeitest eng mit den Kolleg*innen aus Google Ads und Bing Ads für eine ganzheitliche Performance-Sicht zusammen. AI-Integration & Workflow-Innovation: Du treibst den Einsatz von LLMs (z. B. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) für die automatisierte Analyse und Auswertung unserer Kampagnendaten aktiv voran. Du entwickelst Prompts und Workflows für beschleunigtes Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung sowie Optimierungen und agierst als interner Expert für KI-gestützte Marketing-Tools. Kreative Nutzung von KI: Du nutzt generative KI gezielt für Anzeigentexte, Variantentests und Creative-Ideation. In engem Austausch mit dem Design- und Content-Team gibst du als Senior-Ansprechperson fachlichen Input und Feedback. Analyse & Tracking-Setup: Du überwachst und analysierst die Kampagnen-Performance anhand von KPIs (CTR, KUR, ROAS, Conversion Rate) unter Nutzung unseres MMM. Du implementierst Tracking-Tools (Pixel, UTM-Parameter, Conversion-APIs) und stellst eine saubere Datengrundlage sicher. Testing: Du verantwortest das fortlaufende A/B-Testing von Anzeigenformaten, Zielgruppen sowie Budgets und bewertest neue Werbemöglichkeiten sowie KI-Werbeprodukte auf ihr Potenzial für benuta. Mentoring: Du unterstützt bei der fachlichen Anleitung sowie dem Onboarding von Junior-Kolleg*innen im Team und teilst dein KI-Wissen. Stellenanforderungen Dein Profil Ausbildung: Du hast dein Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medien, Kommunikationswissenschaften o. Ä.) erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Relevante Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Meta Ads und/oder anderen Paid-Social-Kanälen mit – idealerweise inklusive nachweisbarer Budget- oder Teilprojektverantwortung. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ist von Vorteil. AI-Expertise (Must-have): Du besitzt praxiserprobte Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools und LLMs im Marketing-Kontext (z. B. Prompting für Reporting, Kampagnenanalysen oder Creative-Unterstützung). Du verfolgst aktuelle AI-Trends aktiv und brennst darauf, eigene Ideen bei benuta einzubringen. Hard Skills: Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse im Meta-Werbeanzeigenmanager und zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten im Umgang mit gängigen Reporting-/Attributions-Tools aus. Erfahrung mit Pinterest, Reddit, TikTok, Bing Ads und serverseitigem Tracking ist ein Plus. Soft Skills: Du arbeitest datengetrieben, denkst lösungsorientiert und begeisterst dich für E-Commerce sowie die Themen Home & Living. Sprachkompetenz: Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind sehr gut (weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus). description: Senior Product Designer 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 💰 £50k-£65k DOE Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK, building the technology estate and letting agents use to run their businesses. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own onboarding for Street.co.uk, our sales and lettings CRM. Switching CRM is a big decision for an estate agency. It means moving years of data, setting up branches, roles and permissions, and getting every agent confident from day one. That makes onboarding one of the most important areas for our growth, and we're rethinking all of it. You'll own the end-to-end journey, from the moment an agency signs to the point their team is running their business on Street.co.uk. You won't be handed a brief. You'll find the problems, decide what matters most, and work with our onboarding team, PMs, engineers, support and commercial to fix them. How we work: Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and test a prototype the same day. We don't guess; we ask. We don't believe in rigid, box-ticking processes. Sometimes you need a deep discovery phase; sometimes you just need to trust your intuition and ship. We trust you to know the difference. Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L5 Senior Product Designer at Street Group Partner with PMs and Engineers to shape the roadmap and decide what we build next. You'll identify problem areas worth solving and propose them - not wait for them to land in your queue. Define what success looks like before you ship. Measure how it performs after release using analytics, support data and customer feedback. Adjust. Jump on calls with users or visit them in-branch to understand pain points and test new workflows. Move from low-fi sketches to high-fidelity prototypes - picking the right tool and fidelity for the job, whether that's Figma, paper, or a Claude Code prototype. Leverage an AI-native, code-first workflow: use tools like Claude Code to "vibe code" small UI tweaks directly in the live product, get instant answers on technical constraints without waiting on engineers, and iterate your designs in the actual browser to drastically speed up feedback loops. Bring AI thinking to what we build, not just how we build it - design AI experiences in the product where they genuinely help users, and call them out where they'd be gimmicks. Why you should (and shouldn't) apply You should apply if: You want to own design end-to-end for significant work in your area - research through to shipping and measuring impact. You think from first principles and don't apply "standard" patterns blindly. You ask questions that narrow down the solution space and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo when you've got the evidence to back it up. You want to ship work that is polished, intuitive, and sets a new standard for the industry. You're commercially fluent - you understand that the user-optimal design isn't always the commercially right one, and you can make that trade-off without losing sleep. You've designed for complex products, and you care about the whole service, not just the screens. You probably shouldn't apply if: You prefer a strict, repetitive rhythm or a linear process without ambiguity, as you will find our pace stressful. You prefer to design in a silo. We challenge each other constantly to get the best result, so if you don't like engineers or PMs questioning your process, this isn't the place. You need to be told exactly what to do. We provide support, but we need people who see a problem and proactively chase the solution. You ship and move on. We expect you to define success upfront and check how the work performed after release. A bit about you Experience: Roughly 5+ years of Product/UX Design experience (SaaS or complex product experience is a bonus). Tooling: Fluent in Figma and confident with modern design systems. Comfortable using AI tools across your workflow, including for shipping small changes directly to production. Research: You plan and run your own user research - picking the right method for the question, knowing how much research is enough to make a decision. Measuring success: You define what success looks like before you ship, and you check what actually happened after. Communication: You can articulate why you made a design decision to an engineer, a PM, or a commercial stakeholder - and adjust how you communicate depending on who's listening.
