At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your mission

Every Product Manager at Catawiki owns a meaningful part of the customer experience.

In Search and Ranking, your mission is to help buyers find the special objects they care about. You will shape how search, ranking and personalisation work across the buyer journey, making discovery more relevant and helping more buyers find objects they love.

This is a broad product area. It brings together buyer needs, expert curation, marketplace priorities, search experiences and machine learning. You will identify the most important opportunities, set a clear direction and lead a cross functional team from insight to measurable customer and business impact.

The solution is not prescribed. You may improve search relevance, ranking, recommendations or personalisation, or explore new AI enabled ways to help buyers discover objects. What matters is that you solve a meaningful customer problem, measure the impact and scale what works.

You will own the strategy, outcomes and execution for this area, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing and Commercial teams.

What you will do

  1. Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for Search and Ranking.
  2. Own measurable outcomes across search relevance, discovery, engagement and buyer conversion.
  3. Use behavioural data, customer research and commercial insight to identify and prioritise the biggest opportunities.
  4. Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, prototypes and executable plans.
  5. Lead initiatives from early discovery through experimentation, launch and scaling.
  6. Define success metrics and build a rigorous experimentation agenda for search, ranking and personalisation.
  7. Work with machine learning engineers and data scientists to assess model quality, test new approaches and improve customer outcomes.
  8. Improve the relevance of search results and recommendations across the buyer journey.
  9. Integrate personalisation into the customer experience in ways that feel useful, coherent and trustworthy.
  10. Design, run and evaluate experiments, using positive, negative and inconclusive results to guide decisions.
  11. Use AI and rapid prototyping to test ideas early, reduce development risk and accelerate learning.
  12. Create clarity, momentum and accountability across teams, including when priorities or incentives differ.
  13. Communicate strategy, performance, tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to senior and C level stakeholders.

Who you are

Three qualities matter most in this role.

Outcome ownership

You take responsibility for customer and business results, not only for delivering features. You stay with the problem, remove obstacles and change direction when the evidence calls for it.

Systems thinking

You understand how search, ranking, recommendations, auction dynamics, expert curation and marketplace health influence one another. You make thoughtful decisions across the full buyer journey.

Experimental rigour

You use data, research, prototypes and controlled experiments to make decisions. You learn from negative results and can distinguish meaningful progress from activity.

You will also bring:

  1. At least five years of product management experience, preferably in consumer ecommerce, marketplaces or another digital product at scale.
  2. Experience owning a broad product area or customer journey, rather than only individual features.
  3. Experience defining product strategy or roadmaps for search, ranking, recommendations, personalisation or other machine learning products.
  4. Confidence working with product metrics, experiments and commercial performance.
  5. Experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests, including tests involving machine learning products.
  6. The ability to turn uncertain opportunities into clear hypotheses, prototypes and plans.
  7. A practical understanding of machine learning concepts and how models become useful product experiences.
  8. Experience working closely with machine learning engineers and data scientists to develop and improve customer facing features.
  9. Comfort using AI tools to prototype quickly and explore customer experiences.
  10. The ability to balance immediate commercial opportunities with longer term product and platform investments.
  11. Clear communication skills and the ability to influence senior leaders without relying on formal authority.
  12. The pace, resilience and judgement to maintain a high standard of execution in an ambiguous environment.

Where you will be

This role is based in Amsterdam. We offer a relocation package for people currently living outside the Netherlands.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

About the role

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.
  • Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.
  • Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.

description:
The Team + The Role

Pendo’s Enterprise Sales team drives growth across the company’s largest and most strategic accounts. The team partners with senior business and technology leaders to position Pendo as a critical platform for product experience, data, analytics, and digital transformation. In DACH, this team plays a key role in expanding Pendo’s presence with major enterprise customers and prospects.

As a Senior Account Executive, you will own new business across Pendo’s largest DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close, with a focus on $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities. This role requires a strategic enterprise seller who can build executive relationships, create disciplined account plans, and position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics solutions with clarity and urgency.

This role is based in our Munich office.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • New logo acquisition: Win new enterprise logos across Germany within Pendo’s most strategic segment. You will identify, engage, and convert high-value opportunities across large DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts.
  • Enterprise sales execution: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close. You will navigate matrixed organizations, align executive buyers, and keep deals moving with clear next steps and strong commercial discipline.
  • Strategic deal leadership: Consistently drive $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities by building value-based business cases. You will position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics platform as a critical driver of digital transformation for enterprise customers.
  • Executive relationship building: Build trusted relationships with C-level leaders and senior decision-makers. You will engage stakeholders with credibility, understand their priorities, and connect Pendo’s capabilities to strategic business outcomes.
  • Account planning: Develop and execute clear, strategic account plans for target enterprise accounts. You will map stakeholders, identify growth opportunities, and create focused plans that support new business acquisition and long-term account potential.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Collaborate across Pendo to win and expand strategic accounts. You will partner with internal teams to bring the right expertise into each opportunity and create a strong, coordinated customer experience.
  • Pipeline and forecast discipline: Maintain accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline management. You will keep opportunity data current, communicate deal progress clearly, and manage your business with structure and accountability.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Account Executives don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

  • Strong track record of closing $500K–$1M+ enterprise SaaS deals across DACH.
  • Experience selling into large, complex, matrixed organizations with multiple senior stakeholders and executive buyers.
  • Proven success in a start-up or high-growth environment, with the ability to operate with structure, urgency, and ownership.
  • Background selling Data, Analytics, AI, or enterprise technology solutions.
  • Passion for AI and technology, with genuine curiosity about how AI is changing the way people work.
  • Confident engagement style with C-level leaders, senior decision-makers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Structured, strategic, and highly self-driven approach to account planning, pipeline management, and deal execution.
  • Fluent German and professional English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling into DAX 40 prospect accounts or similarly large strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Experience positioning AI-powered Data & Analytics solutions as part of broader digital transformation initiatives.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.

Benefits: Robust, employer-backed social coverage paired with additional cash stipends, equity, and meaningful retirement and commute support.

EEOC: We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility: Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. You will focus on enabling the MSSP ecosystem, positioning and integrating SentinelOne's technology within partner technical offerings, selling to the managed partner base, conducting demos, delivering technical training, Proof of Values, assisting partners with pre and post sales activities, and assisting with escalations.   • Experience working with CSPs, channel, MSP/MSSPs, GSIs, or alliances partners.
  • Ability to quickly learn, adapt, understand, and work with new emerging technologies, methodologies and solutions 
  • Fluent Dutch and English
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

description:
About us

Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence

PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.

The Role

PhysicsX is building a platform that enables Data Scientists and Simulation Engineers to build, train, and deploy Deep Physics Models. The platform handles massive volumes of complex simulation data and enables high fidelity multi physics simulation through AI inference.

We are looking for a Senior (potentially Staff level, depending on the candidate) Software Engineer to join the AI Workbench platform team. This is a software engineering role, not an ML research role. You do not need to be a practising ML engineer, but you do need to be fluent in the language of ML and data platforms, ideally through prior hands on experience with ML platforms or data science work.

The team sits in a highly infrastructure heavy domain without being an infrastructure team itself. A large part of the role is building strong working relationships with the infrastructure team and owning the work that falls in the space between the two, where ownership is not always clearly defined. You will also play a key role in mentoring and developing engineers across the team, some of whom are early career and some mid career.

Note for candidates: PhysicsX is currently going through a team reorganisation. The scope of this role may evolve as team structures settle, and we have kept this description intentionally broad rather than narrowly tailored to today's team shape.

What You Will Do

  • Design and build distributed systems, services, and APIs for high dimensional simulation data across the machine learning lifecycle, from data processing and model training to inference services.
  • Own work end to end in a domain where responsibilities often sit between the AIWB platform team and the wider infrastructure team, and proactively build the relationships needed to manage that ambiguity well.
  • Build tools that enable data scientists and engineers to create automated, robust pipelines for data ingestion and processing, powering active learning loops.
  • Architect and integrate storage solutions, data warehouses, and data lakes to handle the demands of complex simulations, multimodal data, and deep learning workloads.
  • Deploy and support services across more than one production environment, including cloud and on premises or air gapped customer environments.
  • Define system architecture for new capabilities, making trade offs across performance, reliability, cost, and developer experience.
  • Author and review Technical Decision Records and contribute to Technology Radar reviews.
  • Mentor and support the growth of engineers across the team, including those earlier in their careers, and act as a technical role model.
  • Remain genuinely hands on. Writing code stays part of the job at every level, this is not a purely managerial track.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with a wide range of stakeholders and personalities across engineering, delivery, and customer facing teams.

What You Bring to the Table

  • A passion for the craft. You are driven by engineering excellence and enjoy building things properly, not just shipping quickly.
  • Strong Kubernetes experience. This is a must have, including comfort with CRDs, Operators, and infrastructure configuration tools such as Helm or ArgoCD.
  • Strong command of Go, plus working knowledge of Python. Comfort with Rust is also valued. Experience across Kubernetes, Go, Python, and Rust is ideal.
  • Experience deploying and supporting services in more than one production environment, not just a single deployment target.
  • An ML platform background or prior data science experience, even if you have since moved into pure software engineering. You understand how ML practitioners and researchers think and talk about problems.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a proactive approach. You do not need to be told what to do next.
  • Strong communication and organisational skills, with experience operating at a senior or staff level, or equivalent people leadership experience, in a comparable engineering organisation.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and an adaptable, startup minded approach. PhysicsX moves quickly and priorities shift, and we are looking for people who thrive in that environment rather than finding it difficult.
  • Prior experience mentoring or developing other engineers.

Ideally

  • Experience at an ML focused startup or platform company, or a strong infrastructure background from a larger organisation such as a bank, provided you can demonstrate adaptability to a smaller, faster moving environment
  • Side projects, open source contributions, or things you have built for their own sake. Not a requirement, but a nice signal of genuine engineering passion.
  • Understanding of what it takes to build and support software across cloud, on premises, and air gapped environments.
  • Experience with big data systems and analytics at scale in production.

What We Offer

  • Equity options, share in our success and growth.
  • 10% employer pension contribution, invest in your future.
  • Free office lunches, great food to fuel your workdays.
  • Flexible working, balance your work and life in a way that works for you.
  • Hybrid setup, enjoy our new Shoreditch office while keeping remote flexibility.
  • Enhanced parental leave, support for life's biggest milestones.
  • Private healthcare, comprehensive coverage.
  • Personal development, access learning and training to help you grow.
  • Work from anywhere, extend your remote setup to enjoy the sun or reconnect with loved ones.

 

 
We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underrepresented in tech to apply. To help make a change, we sponsor bright women from disadvantaged backgrounds through their university degrees in science and mathematics. 
 
We collect diversity and inclusion data solely for the purpose of monitoring the effectiveness of our equal opportunities policies and ensuring compliance with employment and equality legislation. This information is confidential, used only in aggregate form, and will not influence the outcome of your application.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos outils de reporting RH et de la transformation digitale de nos processus People, Decathlon Digital recherche son ou sa futur(e) Stagiaire BI Engineer Workday.

👥 À propos de l'équipe et du rôle

Tu intégreras l'équipe People Data de Decathlon Digital pour participer activement à la valorisation de nos données RH mondiales.

Au cœur du déploiement global de Workday RH auprès de nos 100 000 collaborateurs répartis dans plus de 65 pays, tu auras une opportunité concrète de façonner les outils décisionnels qui soutiennent le développement, le bien-être et la gestion des talents à l'échelle du groupe. 🌍

💡 Pourquoi ce projet vaut le détour

Travailler sur Workday RH chez Decathlon dépasse largement la simple production d'états de reporting :

  • Un écosystème SIRH de pointe : centraliser et fiabiliser la donnée humaine d'une communauté internationale massive via des technologies décisionnelles modernes.
  • Un impact métier direct : transformer des volumes complexes de données en indicateurs clés et tableaux de bord interactifs pour éclairer les décisions stratégiques des dirigeants et des équipes RH. 📊

🛠️ Tes missions

  • Conception et développement de reportings : participer à la création de rapports personnalisés (Custom Reports, Matrix Reports) et de tableaux de bord interactifs (Discovery Boards) sur Workday.
  • Analyse du besoin métier : échanger avec les interlocuteurs RH internationaux pour cadrer leurs indicateurs de performance (KPIs) et les traduire en solutions techniques robustes. 🤝
  • Modélisation et logique calculée : configurer les champs calculés (Calculated Fields) garantissant la finesse et la justesse des analyses collaborateur.
  • Gouvernance et catalogue de données : documenter, organiser et optimiser le catalogue de rapports pour fiabiliser le maintien en conditions opérationnelles, éviter les doublons et assurer l'adoption des outils. 📂
  • Sécurité et conformité : veiller au respect rigoureux de la confidentialité (RGPD) et à la gestion des droits d'accès via les groupes de sécurité (ISG/CSG). 🔒

🎯 Ton profil

  • Formation : étudiant(e) en dernière année de cursus Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, master spécialisé en Data, Informatique décisionnelle ou Business Intelligence).
  • Socle technique : solides bases en SQLet intérêt marqué pour les outils de BI/reporting (Workday, Tableau, Power BI, etc.). 💻
  • Qualités personnelles : rigueur méthodologique, capacité d'analyse, autonomie et curiosité technique.
  • Langues : français courant et bon niveau d'anglais requis (contexte de travail international et interlocuteurs anglophones). 💬

❓ FAQ & Recrutement

Comment se déroule le processus de sélection ?

  1. 📄 Étude de ta candidature avec une réponse sous deux semaines.
  2. 📞 Premier échange RH / technique.
  3. 👥 Entretien avec ton futur responsable d'équipe et un référent métier.
Faut-il être un grand sportif pour postuler ?

Non ! Nous cherchons avant tout des passionnés de données, curieux et motivés par notre dynamique d'équipe, que tu pratiques un sport au quotidien ou non. 🏃‍♂️

Que t'apporte un stage chez Decathlon ?

Une immersion complète sur des projets d'envergure internationale avec un accompagnement dédié. Plus de 50 % de nos stagiaires et alternants poursuivent ensuite leur carrière au sein du groupe en CDI ! 🎉
 

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists: 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business 🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time 🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country As our next Strategic Account Lead, you'll work strategically with the business’ largest tradespartners to grow their business and maximise ROI on Checkatrade, while driving revenue through smarter product adoption. We’re looking for a true end to end relationship and revenue owner - you run and grow your book of business like its own p&l. The job, unfiltered: Own a portfolio of high-value trade businesses end to end, and run a proactive outbound motion that grows revenue by getting them using and optimising the full Checkatrade suite. Build and run a clear monthly plan for every account, shaped by their goals, their data and the realities of their business. Influence decisions at every level, from owner to board, using performance data and a deep understanding of how trade businesses actually make money. Spot blockers before they cost revenue, then fix them. Design the processes and ways of working that make accounts run smoothly, so tradespeople can focus on growing. Build credible, high-trust relationships with senior stakeholders through regular contact and practical, strategic support. You’re their go-to commercial partner, not just their account manager. The fit: A track record of managing and growing a significant book of revenue, with the results to prove it. A hybrid hunter/farmer mindset: hungry to achieve short-term revenue targets, while able to flex into building long-term strategic valued Real ownership of your portfolio, your performance and your commercial outcomes. You don’t wait to be told what to do next. Commercial credibility with senior decision-makers. You can challenge, advise and negotiate, and they listen. Resilience. description:
Notre équipe Ship & Back recherche un·e Support Engineer (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille.

Au cœur de la Value Chain de Decathlon, l'équipe Last Mile Delivery propulse l'expérience sportive au niveau supérieur en garantissant une livraison fluide, rapide et fiable partout dans le monde. Composée d'une dizaine de passionné·es du produit et de la tech, notre mission est d'optimiser le cœur battant de la logistique e-commerce à travers 3 produits clés : Shipperbox (tracking et étiquettes transporteurs), RPM (référentiel des points relais) et Trackbox (assure la livraison des commandes e-commerce, leur suivi et leur performance). En rejoignant notre équipe à taille humaine, tu prendras le lead du support fonctionnel sur un périmètre stratégique, avec l'ambition de garantir une performance de livraison sans faille pour des millions d'utilisateur·rices.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

  • Animer et piloter le support fonctionnel et technique sur l'ensemble de notre scope (Shipperbox, RPM, Trackbox).
  • Incarner la voix de l'utilisateur·rice en garantissant une satisfaction client optimale au quotidien.
  • Adopter une démarche proactive : concevoir, déployer et maintenir des sondes et dispositifs de monitoring pour anticiper et détecter les dysfonctionnements avant l'impact métier.
  • Intervenir avec réactivité lors des incidents critiques et mener les analyses d'impact et de cause racine.
  • Structurer et appliquer des plans d'action post-incident rigoureux pour éliminer durablement la récurrence des problèmes.
  • Identifier les points critiques du scope fonctionnel pour optimiser continuellement la qualité de service et la robustesse de nos outils.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Une expérience confirmée sur un rôle de Support Engineer, idéalement dans le domaine de la Value Chain, de la supply chain ou de la logistique e-commerce.
  • Une réelle obsession pour la satisfaction utilisateur et une curiosité naturelle qui te pousse à creuser les sujets complexes.
  • Un équilibre démontré entre réactivité en gestion d'incident et proactivité dans la mise en place d'outils de surveillance.
  • Une capacité à animer une activité de support et à piloter des plans d'action transversaux.
  • Une sensibilité aux enjeux de l'IA (génération d'alertes intelligentes, automatisation du traitement) pour apporter davantage d'efficience au support est un atout majeur.

STACK TECHNIQUE

  • Observabilité et monitoring : Datadog
  • Gestion des incidents & ITSM : SMAX
  • Architecture Web, APIs et flux de données e-commerce / logistique

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

description: LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South. Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. About the role As UK Entity Controller, reporting to the Head of Financial Control and Reporting, you will own the numbers for our largest and most regulated group of entities: an FCA-authorised e-money institution, a payment institution and our growing consumer credit business. You will lead a small team, run a close the business can rely on every month, and build credit accounting that scales as lending grows. You will help shape a finance function that is lean, well-controlled and built to last - and you will leave clear fingerprints on how we do things. What you'll build and own Own the UK close - deliver an accurate monthly, quarterly and year-end close for every UK entity on the Group timetable, with every material balance substantiated and independently reviewed. Prepare and file FRS 102 statutory accounts on time, act as the auditors' first point of contact for the UK, and track every audit finding and management letter point through to resolution with clear owners and dates. Build and own credit accounting for our consumer credit business: loan book, IFRS 9 expected credit loss, interest and fee income, write-offs and funding facilities - documented, auditable and scalable. Get safeguarding right - sign off the safeguarding requirement calculation for each UK regulated entity and ensure safeguarded funds and customer balances are correctly reflected, reconciled and agreed with Data, Treasury and Reconciliation at month-end. Account accurately for high volumes of multi-currency transactions including FX revaluation and processor and bank balances, and partner with Group Reporting to agree intercompany positions. Partner with FP&A on entity-level forecasts, evaluate capital adequacy and flag rectification needs ahead of regulatory reporting deadlines; give Tax and Regulatory Finance teams reliable data for FCA returns. Raise the control bar - document processes and internal controls, close gaps, embed maker/checker review and segregation of duties, give every critical task a trained backup, and work with Finance Systems and Data to automate close tasks and build reporting that scales. Your experience ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified with 10 or more years of post-qualification experience, including a meaningful stint as an entity or financial controller. Hands-on experience in lending or consumer credit accounting, including IFRS 9 ECL modelling and loan book accounting. Experience working inside an FCA-regulated firm such as an EMI, payment institution, bank or lender. Strong FRS 102 and IFRS technical knowledge with a track record of clean statutory audits and the ability to assess and document the accounting treatment of new products. Comfort with high transaction volumes, multiple currencies and payment processor data; experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP. Proven ability to lead and develop a small accounting team, with a hands-on, low-ego approach - happy to review and to roll up your sleeves. Nice to have Big 4 or similar audit background. Fintech, cross-border payments or remittance experience, ideally with working knowledge of safeguarding under the Electronic Money and Payment Services Regulations. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions. Lead programme steering committees, governance forums, and executive reviews — managing expectations, escalations, and strategic direction with confidence. Contribute to proposals, solution designs, and commercial development for new and adjacent client opportunities; participate actively in pursuit efforts. Support the development of commercial proposals and business cases for agentic AI transformation programmes, including pricing, scope, and delivery approach. Team and Practice Leadership Lead a team of Managers, Associate Managers, and engineers — providing technical and professional coaching, managing performance, and creating conditions for high-quality delivery. Capture and translate expert and unstructured knowledge into ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models, ensuring accuracy and context for automation and insights. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Must have skills : Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform Good to have skills : Data Engineering, Graph Databases, Neo4j Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions using Databricks lakehouse and AI capabilities. The role leads a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, governed data products, lakehouse pipelines, and Databricks engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value. Key Responsibilities Engineer Databricks-based knowledge engineering solutions using Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows, MLflow, Feature Engineering, Vector Search, Model Serving, notebooks, jobs, APIs, and cloud storage integrations. Build lakehouse graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on Databricks while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope. Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly. Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph-powered data and AI offerings. Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions. Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities. Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems. Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods. Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms. Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end-to-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation. Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams. Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands-on design and configuration. Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases. Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program. Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client-facing, and cross-functional teams across multiple time zones. Required Skills/ Experience Hands-on experience building Databricks-based knowledge engineering solutions with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows, MLflow, Feature Engineering, Vector Search, Model Serving, notebooks, jobs, APIs, and cloud storage integrations. Strong Python, SQL, and Spark/PySpark experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling. Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise-scale LLM applications. Ability to design and implement scalable lakehouse graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic layers, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG pipelines, and governed knowledge services. Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Good to Have Skills 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud/data platforms, with Databricks specialization and exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP in multi-cloud environments. Databricks certifications such as Data Engineer Professional, Machine Learning Professional, or related lakehouse credentials. Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including domain ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge-driven use cases. External client-facing consulting experience, proposal support, solution shaping, or pre-sales exposure. Advanced degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline broad exposure to diverse ML techniques and agentic systems. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. You Are: We are looking for a Back-End Engineer to design, build, and operate the data infrastructure and services that power our AI-driven knowledge platform. description: About the Centre for Advanced Data APAC The Centre for Advanced Data (C4AD) is Accenture's specialist centre of excellence that sets the architecture standard for modern, AI-ready data estates across APAC, and mobilises the talent to deliver them at scale. The C4AD operates across three core disciplines: Master Data Architecture, Knowledge Engineering, and Data Products. Every practitioner in the C4AD is expected to apply agentic and generative techniques as the default way of working, not as an add-on. The centre supports large-scale data and AI transformation programmes across the region, ranging from enterprise data modernisation to AI-ready platform builds. Job Description Join the Centre for Advanced Data APAC as a Knowledge Engineer, where you will own ontology and semantic strategy across engagements, set the knowledge-engineering standards for the practice, and assure the semantic layers that ground enterprise AI. You will define how the C4AD approaches knowledge representation across programmes, and hold the line on quality, consistency, and semantic integrity as those programmes scale. You will work closely with Data Architects and AI Engineers, ensuring that the ontologies and knowledge graphs you define and govern give AI systems something real, structured, and reliable to reason over. Project Description / Key Responsibilities Own ontology and semantic strategy across C4AD engagements, setting the approach, standards, and quality bar for knowledge engineering across the practice. Assure semantic layers that ground enterprise AI, reviewing, governing, and signing off on the ontological structures that AI systems in our programmes reason over. Design, develop, and govern enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graphs that accurately represent business domains, their relationships, and the rules that govern them. Build and govern semantic models using RDF/OWL, SHACL, and SPARQL, and property graph approaches using platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog. Apply and adapt industry-standard ontologies (e.g. FIBO, BIAN, GS1, TM Forum) to meet organisation-specific semantic requirements. Develop and enforce semantic modelling standards, naming conventions, versioning, and curation workflows, and drive adoption of those standards across delivery teams. Enable AI and ML applications through knowledge graph enrichment, entity resolution, semantic search, and ontology-powered RAG pipelines. Engage business SMEs and domain experts to elicit and formalise implicit business rules, relationships, and concepts into explicit ontological structures. Key Skills 5+ years of experience in knowledge engineering, ontology design, or semantic modelling, with a track record of owning the knowledge engineering approach on complex programmes, not just contributing to it. Proven deep expertise in ontology engineering, authoring OWL ontologies, RDFS schemas, SHACL constraint shapes, and SPARQL queries, with real enterprise delivery behind it. Hands-on experience with graph databases and knowledge graph platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or GraphDB. Proficiency with semantic tooling including Protégé, TopBraid Composer, or equivalent ontology authoring environments. Strong understanding of how semantic models connect to downstream data products, metadata catalogues, and AI/ML enrichment workflows, and the ability to assure that integration is sound. title: Knowledge Engineer

description: VOUS ÊTES Vous êtes un solide contributeur individuel en ingénierie des connaissances évoluant vers un rôle de chef d'équipe. Vous maîtrisez l'ensemble du cycle de vie du développement des graphes de connaissances. Vous transformez des problèmes du monde réel en solutions pratiques, efficaces et évolutives basées sur l'IA et les graphes de connaissances, en travaillant de manière opérationnelle sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie, de l'ingestion à la modélisation, la curation et le déploiement. Vous appliquez les méthodologies, techniques et algorithmes actuels avec l'architecture appropriée et commencez à guider les ingénieurs juniors sur le projet. Vous restez à jour sur l'ingénierie des connaissances, l'IA générative, les LLM et les modèles multimodaux ; vous recherchez les opportunités de les appliquer au problème traité. Vous concevez, évaluez et maintenez les ontologies lorsque cela est nécessaire. Vous contribuez à démontrer la valeur des approches basées sur l'IA générative et les graphes de connaissances pour un problème métier donné. Vous partagez vos apprentissages avec l'équipe. Vous collaborez avec les utilisateurs, les représentants des cas d'usage, les ingénieurs, les architectes et les concepteurs UI afin de fournir votre contribution à une solution de bout en bout. LE TRAVAIL Construire des composants de graphe de connaissances qui contribuent à la transformation de l'architecture de données d'un client. Concevoir, développer et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'IA et des solutions sémantiques ; veiller à ce que votre travail s'intègre proprement au système global. Travailler aux côtés de l'équipe projet et des responsables de delivery. Établir de solides relations de travail avec les interlocuteurs clients de votre domaine d'activité. Aider à rassembler les éléments justificatifs soutenant la solution de couche sémantique recommandée. Soutenir les efforts commerciaux d'Accenture lorsque cela est demandé. Continuer à développer vos compétences dans les solutions Data & AI de pointe, en particulier les technologies agentiques, et partager ces connaissances avec l'équipe. QUALIFICATIONS DE BASE (REQUIS) Diplôme de licence ou équivalent, ainsi qu'au moins 3 des éléments suivants : Expérience avec les technologies de Knowledge Graph (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL) Expérience démontrée en conception de schémas, gestion d'ontologies et curation de Knowledge Graphs Familiarité avec la conception et le développement de solutions de Knowledge Graph et de modèles de machine learning basés sur les graphes (fonctionnel + technique) Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de pipelines de données de bout en bout pour les applications d'IA (en particulier les LLM), avec une expérience pratique de la conception et de la configuration Solides connaissances et expérience des bases de données relationnelles, des stockages objets, des bases de données graphe (Stardog, Neo4J, Amazon Neptune) et des bases de données vectorielles (aucune exigence en matière de leadership ou de développement commercial à ce niveau) QUALIFICATIONS PRÉFÉRÉES Expérience pratique avec les plateformes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) Expérience professionnelle avec Python, ainsi qu'avec des frameworks tels que TensorFlow, PyTorch et des outils de création de pipelines ETL (par exemple Apache NiFi, Airflow) Expérience pratique des techniques de NLP et/ou de recherche Prompt engineering et LLMs pour des applications à l'échelle de l'entreprise Vous avez une expérience de chef d'équipe Solides compétences en collaboration avec la capacité de travailler au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie, de recherche et de produit réparties sur plusieurs fuseaux horaires Vous avez une expérience de conseil en contact direct avec des clients externes Expérience étendue de diverses techniques de machine learning et des systèmes agentiques. description: UKI Finance RP Finance Data Engineer The practice Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role. Purpose of the role Responsible for the finance data and ontology layer on which agentic solutions depend. Builds the entities, relationships, definitions, lineage and data contracts sourced from live ERP and EPM systems to a standard that supports controlled and auditable agent behaviour. The role owns governed finance data products, semantic models and retrieval-ready data services that are secure, permission-aware, observable and suitable for AI, analytics and decision intelligence. Responsibilities Build and extend the finance ontology covering supplier, invoice, customer, receivable, journal, account, cost centre and forecast line, and the relationships between them, including controlled vocabularies, business glossaries, hierarchy history, ownership and lifecycle versioning. Engineer pipelines from SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM platforms into governed data products, supporting structured and unstructured sources, batch and incremental ingestion, APIs, files and change-data-capture patterns as appropriate. Build entity-resolution and master or reference-data capabilities that reconcile identifiers, definitions and hierarchies across source systems and preserve source-to-target mappings. Establish lineage and evidence sufficient for audit, so that agent output can be traced to source, with automated data-quality checks, finance reconciliations, completeness and freshness measures, observability, alerts and recoverable operations. Define data contracts between delivery pods, and between Accenture delivery and client platform teams, including schemas, quality thresholds, access rules, service levels, versioning and change-control expectations. Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. Work with AI Engineers on retrieval and grounding, ensuring models receive appropriately scoped context, including chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid or graph retrieval, permission-aware filtering, provenance and retrieval evaluation. Implement security and privacy controls across the data lifecycle, including role- or attribute-based access, row or document-level permissions, masking or tokenisation, retention, tenant isolation and audit logging. Apply software and DataOps practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code where relevant, performance tuning, cost optimisation and production support. Collaborate with finance SMEs, data owners, architects and governance teams to agree definitions, resolve data issues and embed sustainable stewardship and operating ownership. Data engineering Essential experience Production data engineering, including SQL, Python, a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric, and orchestration tooling, with practical experience of ETL/ELT, data testing, Git and CI/CD; PySpark or dbt experience is beneficial. Working knowledge of finance data structures, including chart of accounts, entity hierarchy, sub-ledger to ledger relationships, intercompany and period close, together with actual, budget and forecast data, currencies, consolidation and management hierarchies. Strong data modelling discipline and the ability to justify and maintain definitional standards, including canonical or semantic models, data contracts, schema evolution, metadata, lineage and data-quality controls. Experience extracting and reconciling data from enterprise applications or complex operational systems using APIs, files, database interfaces or change-data-capture patterns. Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc. using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. (AI engineer – desirable) Understanding of secure data engineering, including access control, encryption, secrets, privacy, retention and the handling of sensitive or regulated data. Ability to work with finance SMEs and technical teams to translate business definitions and controls into implementable data products and acceptance criteria. At least 10 years’ relevant professional experience Knowledge graph, semantic layer or ontology engineering experience, including technologies or standards such as Neo4j, RDF/OWL, SKOS, SPARQL or GraphRAG. Data quality, master data management or lineage tooling experience, including entity resolution, business glossaries, catalogues or platforms such as Collibra, Purview or Unity Catalog. Exposure to SOX or external audit requirements, GDPR, model-risk controls or regulated-data environments. Detailed knowledge of one or more finance-platform data models, such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday Financials, Anaplan, OneStream or SAP Analytics Cloud. Experience evaluating retrieval quality for AI workloads, including embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search or reranking. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers. Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks. Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments. Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations. Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures. description: Application deadline: Oct 17, 2026 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build. You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. description: The vision of the Product Knowledge Ontology Team is to provide a standardized, semantically rich, easily discoverable, extensible, and universally applicable body of product knowledge that can be consistently utilized across customer shopping experiences, selling partner listing experiences and internal enrichment of product data. We aim to make product knowledge compelling, easy to use, and feature rich. Our work to build comprehensive product knowledge allows us to semantically understand a customer’s intent – whether that is a shopping mission or a seller offering products. We strive to make these experiences more intuitive for all customers. As an Ontologist, you work on a global team of knowledge builders to deliver world-class, intuitive, and comprehensive taxonomy and ontology models to optimize product discovery for Amazon web and mobile experiences. You collaborate with business partners, data science and engineering teams to deliver knowledge-based solutions to enable product discoverability for customers. In this role, you will directly impact the customer experience as well as the company’s product knowledge foundation. We’re working to be the most customer-centric company on earth and Amazon's Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering (C-RME) team is at the heart of that mission, using science and data to drive scalable maintenance best practices across Amazon business units globally. We are seeking a Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist to lead key semantic layer and knowledge intelligence initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of knowledge engineering, ontology design, and applied AI, owning workstreams for the development of semantic foundations and dedicated science approaches that ensure their accuracy, consistency, and explainability in service of agentic and non-agentic AI across RME. Key job responsibilities In this role, you will contribute to the success of Central and Field RME teams working with new launches of Amazon buildings, as well as ensure that our Field teams benefit from state-of-the art AI solutions to support Global Operational Excellence. You will closely work with our team of senior scientists and systems engineers in our knowledge intelligence team, which is leading the full lifecycle of graph-based AI solutions, from customer problem formulation and ontology design to production deployment, enabling network-wide data discovery, decision support, and compliance monitoring. A core part of your mandate is to lead the semantic modelling and ontological foundation layer that supports both explainability and retrieval capabilities. This foundation feeds into transversal initiatives spanning multiple teams and products involving multiple AI approaches. You will closely work with Senior Applied Scientists owning explainability, causal reasoning, intelligent retrieval and question answering over knowledge graphs. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist, you will: • lead the semantic layer for agentic AI, including developing and assessing the ontological foundations that enable autonomous workflows and cross-site best practice sharing. design, build, and deploy graph-based AI solutions that combine knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and ML models to extract meaning from large-scale unstructured document collections, enabling data discovery, classification, and governance across RME • define and own knowledge pipelines that extract, transform, and enrich entity relationships from diverse unstructured and semi-structured sources into production-grade knowledge graphs, ensuring reliability and accuracy of the overall information architecture • collaborate with fellow senior scientists to design, deploy, and operate graph and vector databases to support retrieval, causal reasoning, and analytics use case as well as ensure contributing scientists maintain versioning, validation state, and provenance for every knowledge graph entry • collaborate with fellow senior applied scientists to ensure ontology and schema design decisions optimize for queryability, so that question-answering and retrieval entity extraction, and semantic analysis, applying rigorous experimentation and evaluation methodology to select the best fit-for purpose approach • design ontological structures that support explainability, enabling agents and reasoning systems to trace reasoning paths and surface provenance, enabling governance-level transparency for autonomous AI actions • optimize models and inference pipelines for production constraints including latency, throughput, cost, and infrastructure reliability • establish best practices and standards for knowledge engineering and applied science description: About the Metropolitan Museum of Art The Met presents over 5,000 years of art from around the world for everyone to experience and enjoy. The Museum lives in two iconic sites in New York City—The Met Fifth Avenue and The Met Cloisters. Millions of people also take part in The Met experience online. Since its founding in 1870, The Met has always aspired to be more than a treasury of rare and beautiful objects. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and respectful work environment with a staff as diverse as the audiences we engage. Our staff members are art lovers who are passionate about working toward a common goal: creating the most dynamic and inspiring art museum in the world. At The Met, every staff member – from security officers to researchers to scientists and beyond – lives by our core values of respect, inclusivity, collaboration, excellence, and integrity. Respect: Engage one another with collegiality, empathy, and kindness, always. Inclusivity: Ensure that all are and feel welcome and valued. Collaboration: Reach across boundaries to exchange ideas and work together toward our shared mission. Excellence: Lead the cultural world in quality and expertise—and inspire curiosity and creativity. Integrity: Hold ourselves to the highest moral standards, admit when we fall short, and then evolve. ABOUT WATSON LIBRARY Thomas J. Watson Library is The Met's research library. With its collection of more than one million volumes, extensive digital collections, and online resources, Watson Library is one of the world's most comprehensive art libraries. The library's holdings reflect the global and encyclopedic nature of The Met, with books ranging in date from the late fifteenth century to current scholarship, in all fields covered by The Met. The library's mission is to support the research activities of the Museum staff and to offer access and outstanding services to an international community of students and scholars. The staff of the Sherman Fairchild Center for Book Conservation are responsible for the preservation of Watson’s collection, and for other Met departmental collections. GENERAL STATEMENT OF RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES: This position performs original and complex copy cataloging adhering to current national and international standards (e.g., RDA, LCNAF, LCSH, PCC); engages in name authority record creation (NACO); contributes to the department’s continued engagement with reparative cataloging practices; and increases awareness, discoverability, and use of the library’s collections through publications, presentations, programs, digitization, and social media. description: 岗位名称： FDE实习生 - Accelerator Team 工作性质： 全职实习生 招聘人数： 1-2人 工作地点： 北京 组别简介 自创院以来，微软亚洲研究院 Accelerator Team致力于连接研究、人才、创新生态，以及不同国家与区域，构建开放协同的创新网络。该团队加速研究的同时推动创新从实验室走向真实世界，赋能微软亚洲研究院打造面向未来的 AI 创新生态。 当下，该团队致力于探索 AI-Native 的创新工作方式，并将前沿人工智能能力转化为可落地的应用与工具。团队聚焦大语言模型、AI Agent、检索增强生成（RAG）、工作流自动化及知识管理等方向，通过快速原型、真实场景验证和持续迭代，提升团队生产力、协作效率与组织创新能力。 工作职责 1. 与 Accelerator 团队紧密合作，围绕科研协作、人才发展、知识管理及组织智能等真实场景，设计并构建 AI Native 应用、智能 Agent 与自动化工作流，助力提升研究效率与创新能力。 2. 快速理解开放性问题，将复杂需求转化为可落地的 AI 解决方案，通过快速原型开发、持续实验与迭代验证，不断优化真实用户场景中的产品体验与价值。 3. 参与 AI Native 产品的全生命周期，包括需求分析、方案设计、技术实现、效果评估、部署优化及持续迭代，共同推动创新项目落地。 任职要求 计算机、工程或其他相关专业的本科、硕士或博士在读或者gap-year学生优先，同时欢迎具备相关能力和项目经验的跨学科同学申请。 具备良好的编程能力，熟悉至少一种主流编程语言，能够熟练运用 AI 辅助编程（Vibe Coding）完成原型开发，并具有实际项目经验。 乐于探索 AI-Native 的工作方式，能够快速学习和应用新工具、新技术与新框架，通过快速验证和迭代提升团队协作与工作效率。探索并应用前沿 AI 技术，包括大语言模型（LLMs）、AI Agents、多 Agent 协作、Context Engineering、RAG、Knowledge Graph、Memory、Tool Use 等，推动 AI 在科研组织中的创新应用。 具备良好的沟通与协作能力，能够理解开放性需求并将其转化为可落地的 AI 解决方案。 能够熟练使用英语作为工作语言。 能够获得导师的书面同意。 加分项（满足任意一项即可） • 有 AI Agent、Copilot、LLM 应用或 AI 自动化工具相关项目经验。 • 有使用 OpenAI API、Azure AI 或其他 AI 平台完成实际项目的经验。 • 有个人 AI 项目、Hackathon、开源项目或产品开发经验。 • 有 Workflow Automation、知识管理、数据分析或内部效率工具开发经验。 • 乐于尝试新技术，并能够快速将新的 AI 能力应用到真实场景中。 实习时间要求 能获得导师许可，并保证至少三个月的全职实习。 申请方式 请下载并填写申请表（ https://aka.ms/InternApplication ），并将申请表与完整的中英文简历（PDF/Word 格式）一同发送至 MSRAih@microsoft.com。邮件标题请注明： FDE实习生-Accelerator Team 了解更多“明日之星实习生计划”： https://www.msra.cn/zh-cn/connections/academic-programs/tomorrowstars

It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision:  At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.   As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Role: We are aiming to hire someone in the the UK, Czechia or Italy. Product Engineering at GraphAware offers a unique opportunity to build real-world intelligence systems that matter. Build with purpose: Your code will help law enforcement and analysts save lives and protect communities through better data insight. Innovative tech: Work with knowledge graphs, workflow engines, LLMs, and graph-native UIs pushing the boundaries of data analytics. Shape the future: Contribute to product direction and technical vision alongside a senior engineering team. True autonomy: Own your work, from ideation to deployment.Global mindset: Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, data scientists, and product thinkers across Europe and beyond. Growth without bureaucracy: Develop your skills in a non-micromanaged, excellence-driven environment. What you will be doing As Tech Lead, you will own core parts of the platform layer of GraphAware Hume, our graph-powered analytics platform — the foundations that cut across every development group and that every feature team builds on. You'll be sought out across the organisation for technical guidance on graph architecture, and expected to anticipate issues at the product level before they surface. Neo4j sits at the heart of the product, we need someone who goes beyond using it well, and actively tracks new features, tests them against real workloads, and identifies where they can move the product forward. Working hands-on with Neo4j at the heart of the product, you will drive the architecture that lets us model, query, and scale the knowledge graphs our users depend on. Your responsibilities will include: Driving platform architecture, setting technical direction for the transversal foundations that feature teams across Hume build on, and shaping cross-cutting design decisions with the wider engineering group Owning our Neo4j strategy : actively tracking and hands-on testing of new releases and ecosystem tooling (GDS, APOC, etc.) to assess breaking changes, propose new product opportunities, and plan deliberate, scalable migrations. Optimizing Cypher queries and graph access patterns for latency, throughput, and scale Mentoring engineers and raising the team's technical bar (especially in Neo4j), without formal management authority Partner closely with Product Managers: to translate long-term product goals into scalable technical roadmaps Designing secure, scalable access control systems for mission-critical environments Building APIs for intuitive user interaction with complex data Orchestrating workflows to automate graph analytics, inference, and real-time insights What you must know already and be excited to grow further Deep, hands-on Neo4j expertise, including advanced Cypher query performance optimization, profiling, and deep familiarity with the broader Neo4j ecosystem (e.g., GDS, APOC, drivers). Modelled real domains as property graphs and can reason about nodes, relationships, labels, and properties as a first-class design activity (relational modelling with e.g. PostgreSQL is a plus) Track record of leading architecture and  technical direction for a team or product area, not just contributing to decisions made by others Proven ability to drive consensus: across engineering teams for large-scale architectural changes. Proven experience in backend systems (8+ years) with exposure to large-scale, complex applications and cross-functional teams Fluency in Java (or a strong JVM background you can bring to a Java codebase) , with a deep understanding of modern software engineering principles, including: Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Test-Driven Development (TDD) Advanced debugging and profiling techniques, Writing composable, maintainable, and testable code Spring or similar frameworks with emphasis on building secure, modular, and scalable APIs Working knowledge of modern CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and automated deployment workflows Strong security mindset , with practical knowledge of secure software design and common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP) Comfortable with remote team collaboration , i.e. tools and practices for asynchronous communication Bonus points for familiarity with: Knowledge graphs and GraphRAG: building knowledge graphs and grounding LLMs with graph-based retrieval (e.g. neo4j-graphrag, LangChain, LlamaIndex) Graph algorithms and analytics: (pathfinding, centrality, community detection) via Neo4j GDS, plus event-driven architectures, Kafka, or distributed systems Evolving large graph data models: over time: schema refactoring, migrations, and versioning as the domain grows Cloud-native development: observability, and performance tuning Italy only: The gross annual salary (RAL) range for this role when based in Italy is €60.000-€75.000. Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.  Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. The Role: We're looking for a software engineer to join the Neo4j Sharding Engineering team. We own Infinigraph and Composite , and we make them work as managed offerings on Aura, Neo4j’s cloud platform. Aura is Neo4j’s fully managed graph database as a service. Customers create, scale, and use Neo4j databases in the cloud without installing, clustering, or operating the database themselves. Aura runs on Kubernetes across Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure, and handles provisioning, networking, security, upgrades, and day-to-day operations for those databases. Composite is the technology behind distributed query execution in Neo4j: one query can span multiple databases. Infinigraph is our database sharding offering for large data volumes, built on a distributed database architecture. Distributed query execution is a complex and interesting topic covering query language design, performant networking, and concurrency. Those capabilities still have to run as a cloud product, and that's where a large part of this role sits: building the Go services and Kubernetes machinery that provision, scale, and operate sharded and composite clusters on Aura, reliably, at the data volumes our customers keep growing into. As part of an energetic and fun team of engineers, you'll work at the frontier of designing and implementing new capabilities for Neo4j on Aura. What the work is like Building and evolving the Aura control plane for sharded and composite databases in Go, so shards, composite instances, clusters, and their lifecycles are managed declaratively through Kubernetes instead of by hand. That includes APIs, operators, and the plumbing that takes a customer request on Aura through to a running, reachable database. Alongside coding features, we track down easy and tough bugs, fix downstream test failures, document features, join cross-team design meetings, and study the latest database research. Daily stand-ups, design meetings, and retrospectives. You'll also spend time learning, thinking, and experimenting. Strong Kubernetes experience, including the built-in resources such as Pods, Deployments, and StatefulSets, and what it takes to run stateful workloads on them. Experience with modern continuous integration: configuring pipelines that take software from a merged PR to a running production environment, and building and running Docker images. Ability to work independently within a flexible software development organisation. Ability to communicate about, and collaborate on, complex topics. Nice to bring Java, Scala, or other JVM experience. Much of the database itself is written in Java, so this helps you go deeper over time. Experience with asynchronous and reactive programming. Experience of distributed systems through usage, administration, or development, and an interest in recent distributed systems developments, academic or industrial.
